notes.title: CrossCode 7th Anniversary, “The Last Final Hotfix – Part 1.2.4-4” and More Plush
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/RFG_7th_Anniversary-600x338.jpg[/img]
Artwork by [url=https://yuikannon.carrd.co/]YuiKannon[/url]

Hello everyball!

Some of you may remember the [b]1.0 version[/b] of CrossCode being released [b]7 years ago[/b], in the ancient year of [b]2018[/b]… Yes, it has been that long, we find it hard to believe ourselves!

But alas, time marches on without mercy. At least something good gets finished now and then, right?

[h2]Hotfix 1.2.4-4[/h2]
There was still another hotfix with a collection of [b]small fixes[/b] in the pipeline and what would be a better opportunity for its release than now?
[list][*]Fixed a rare crash in the options menu (hopefully! we never got it ourselves)[/*]
 	[*]Various Typos that somehow survived this long.[/*]
 	[*]A bunch of minor mapping mistakes, including one hidden soft-lock hole.[/*][/list]Surely, hopefully and maybe this will actually be the real, legit final one this time!!

[h2]More CrossCode Plushies[/h2]
After the [b][url=https://www.makeship.com/products/lea-plush]Smug Lea Plush[/url][/b] was a huge success, we posted [b][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd-BOwPg4-FDZNsB2LhSHGAxnwvWTJIVoCc0q19WGfLTlWm4w/viewform]a poll for more merch[/url][/b] in an earlier post, which we used to determine potential merch for a later time. Well, that time is now upon us!

Behold, 3 more plushies!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/RadicalFishGames_Launch_Socials_20250829_v1-600x600.png[/img]

A smug redhead, a grasshead and a grumpy sister [strike]walk into a bar[/strike] have appeared in our office. These are examples of the next group of [b]limited plushies[/b] that will star in our newest collaboration with [b]Makeship[/b], starting NOW and running [b]for 21 days[/b]!

[b][url=https://www.makeship.com/products/emilie-plushie]Emilie Plushie Campaign[/url][/b]

[b][url=https://www.makeship.com/products/apollo-plushie]Apollo Plushie Campain[/url][/b]

[b][url=https://www.makeship.com/products/shizuka-plushie]Shizuka Plushie Campaign[/url][/b]

As already explained with Lea's campaign, every character plush will be its own campaign that needs to reach 200 backers to be produced. If it's successful, the goodies will ship about [b]2-4 months later[/b]! Consult Makeship's [b][url=https://www.makeship.com/how-it-works]“How it Works”[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://www.makeship.com/faq]FAQ[/url][/b] pages if you have more questions about how it works!

[h2]Alabaster Dawn now has a DEMO[/h2]
Our new game [b]Alabaster Dawn[/b] now hit another major milestone!

This week we released a [b]free demo[/b] that you can now play on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3900710/Alabaster_Dawn_Demo/

And in case you didn't hear about Alabaster Dawn before: It's an Action RPG similar to CrossCode, but with a [b]2.5D Pixel Art Look[/b], [b]multiple weapons[/b] and [b]a world that changes as you play[/b]!

If that sounds like something you like, go give it a try!

And that's all for today's Anniversary!

Until next time!

notes.title: CrossCode Merch Poll + Concert Videos
notes.notes:
[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/RFG_June_2025.jpg][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/RFG_June_2025-600x338.jpg[/img][/url]

Greetings everyball and happy Pride Month!! 🏳‍🌈

A couple of months have passed and we've got news regarding CrossCode merch! Also a concert and an update for our new project!
 
[h2]The Smug Lea Plush and Maybe More?[/h2]

In our last post in January we announced a [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/lea-plush][b]Makeship crowdfunding campaign for a Smug Lea Plush[/b][/url], which was an overwhelming success! Exactly 4.000 units were ordered, which means that it reached a funding of 2.000% or 20 times of its mandatory goal!

Over the past 2 weeks we noticed happy fans posting about the arrival of their personal Smug Leas so we hope that yours have reached you by now or will soon as well!

Now, with the popularity of this campaign, the question for [b]further CrossCode merch[/b] arises! For this purpose we created a poll to to collect some opinions from you, our fans:

[b][url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd-BOwPg4-FDZNsB2LhSHGAxnwvWTJIVoCc0q19WGfLTlWm4w/viewform]THE MERCH POLL![/url][/b]

We are interested which characters you’d want to have for additional plushies and also what kind of additional types merch you would want to have.

Thank you for taking the time to share your opinion with us!

 
[h2]GAME ECHO Concert, feat. CrossCode[/h2]
Our composer [b]Deniz Akbulut[/b] (going by “Nagi Shirakumo” in Japan) and his classmate [b]Hibiki Utagawa[/b] co-founded [b][url=https://www.instagram.com/gameecho2023/]Game Echo[/url][/b], an officially recognized club in [u]Kunitachi College of Music[/u]. Together they arrange and perform various video game music in concerts, including wind band and orchestra. 
You might remember [b][url=https://youtu.be/Y7okB6wWXCo]their arrangement of [u]Lea![/u][/url][/b] from last year, fully written by Deniz himself!

On this year’s March 25th they performed the [u]The Ultimate Experience[/u] for wind band, arranged by Utagawa-san.

[previewyoutube=IbuWF4b4igs;full][ INSERT VIDEO ][/previewyoutube]

Also part of the concert was a medley of [u]Klonoa 2: Lunatea’s Veil[/u], arranged by Deniz!

[previewyoutube=LHOApCGHgdo;full][ INSERT VIDEO ][/previewyoutube]

And on that note, congratz to Deniz for graduating!

[h2]Alabaster Dawn Update[/h2]

We wanted to also give you an update about our new game project [b]Alabaster Dawn[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3110760/Alabaster_Dawn

The biggest new feature is the [b]Cinematics system[/b] which helps us deliver visually dynamic cutscenes outside of the usual ingame-perspective.

[previewyoutube=aooheA8TGYI;full][ INSERT VIDEO ][/previewyoutube]

Of course new content also requires new enemies to fight. And, as old wisdom goes, giving someone a fish might feed them for a day but implementing a fish enemy will allow them to punch fish for a lifetime! … Anyway, look at these [b]flying fish[/b]… They fly and shoot lightning, is that cool or what?!

[previewyoutube=e6ArcNILTvU;full][ INSERT VIDEO ][/previewyoutube]

Another new interesting enemy is a turtle. Wait, we already introduced it? Well, but now it’s [u][b]angry[/b][/u]! Which means higher stats and new attack patterns! Expect to see variations like that to truly test your skills in special battles now and then.

[previewyoutube=WP5vnSAhKio;full][ INSERT VIDEO ][/previewyoutube]

On the quality-of-life side, we realized that the swapping between weapons to match enemy weaknesses has been pretty annoying early on, when only one element is available. Our solution was a [b]Loadout option[/b] that allows players to simply swap weapon combinations with a single button-press!

[previewyoutube=7rJD3QNSJg8;full][ INSERT VIDEO ][/previewyoutube]

To improve the atmosphere and immersion of our world, [b]travelling NPCs[/b] have been added, like these restless caravans that are diligently delivering crucial cargo between predefined stations.

[previewyoutube=fXjb-8_z768;full][ INSERT VIDEO ][/previewyoutube]

And, on the visual side, our [b]weather effect system[/b] has been further improved and can dynamically change the vibe of your journey with flying leafs, rain and clouds.

[previewyoutube=L_A9OZoX-RU;full][ INSERT VIDEO ][/previewyoutube]

Other work, not shown yet still essential, includes [b]more sidequests[/b] and further progress with the [b]second and third areas[/b] of the game!
 
[h2]Our current Focus on Alabaster Dawn + Introducing...[/h2]

On a more general note, we're still working a [b]public demo version[/b] for Alabaster Dawn, which is supposed include a proper [b]prologue[/b] properly introducing the setting of the game!

And on the topic of the story, we think it is about time we finally properly introduced [b]another team member[/b] who has actually already been supporting our writing process since an early stage: Enter [b]Luke “Lun Calsari” Wacholtz![/b]

Some of you old-timey fans of the RPG Maker 2k scene (like many of our team…) might know him as the creator behind the cult classic [b]The Way[/b], while others might have experienced his newer work, as a writer in [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/506510/Shadows_of_Adam/]Shadows of Adam[/url][/b] or his recent own project, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1114950/Learn_Japanese_RPG_Hiragana_Forbidden_Speech/]Learn Japanese RPG: Hiragana Forbidden Speech[/url][/b]!

In Alabaster Dawn he has already played an essential role in further fleshing out the scenario and characters and is also a great help in polishing up our dialogues to make them more snappy and incorporate diverse yet internally consistent styles of speech!

But lets give Luke the stage to introduce himself:
[u]"Hello! I’m a wanderer, game developer, and writer with a passion for cool tech and storytelling. I’ve spent tens of thousands of hours crafting RPGs, including The Way and Learn Japanese RPG: Hiragana Forbidden Speech. I also contributed to Shadows of Adam, and now—most exciting of all—I’m thrilled to join the team behind Alabaster Dawn!"[/u]

[h2]Indie Shout-out: Yarn Guardians[/h2]
For the end of this post we want to give a quick shout-out to the our friends and fellow German developer [u]Pentapaw Studios[/u] and their upcoming game [b]Yarn Guardians[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2928940/Yarn_Guardians/

Take control of various adorable flying kitties and fight your way through hordes of only slightly less cute enemies using [b]BALLS[/b]… Yarn balls! And a variety of other yarn-themed weapons.

And best of all, you can play it in [b]coop with a friend[/b]!

All of this cuteness has been animated by [b][url=https://bsky.app/profile/did:plc:35jc4aulrjdlqqdw4conatjx]VanAnimation[/url][/b], who also animated Lea and Juno in their respective game trailers!

 
[h2]Socials[/h2]


[b]Bluesky[/b]: [url=https://bsky.app/profile/radicalfishgames.com]https://bsky.app/profile/radicalfishgames.com[/url]

[b]Community Discord:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/radicalfish]https://discord.gg/radicalfish[/url]

[b]Instagram[/b]: [url=https://www.instagram.com/radicalfishgames/]https://www.instagram.com/radicalfishgames/[/url]

[b]TikTok[/b]: [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@radicalfishgames]https://www.tiktok.com/@radicalfishgames[/url]

[b]Twitch:[/b] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/radicalfishgames]https://www.twitch.tv/radicalfishgames[/url]

[b]Twitter[/b]: [url=https://twitter.com/RadicalFishGame/]https://twitter.com/RadicalFishGame/[/url]

[b]YouTube:[/b] [url=https://www.youtube.com/@RadicalFishGames]https://www.youtube.com/@RadicalFishGames[/url]

Followers and Subscribers are always appreciated!

As always, thank you for reading our updates and for your continued support!

Until next time!

notes.title: Smug Lea Plush now available for a limited time!
notes.notes:
[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/plush-header.jpg]
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/plush-header-600x338.jpg[/img][/url]

Greetings everyball! We haven't posted here for some time but today is a special occasion!

[h2]Presenting: The Smug Lea Plush[/h2]

After years of passionate fan demand we can finally present the [b]new and extra smug Lea plush[/b], in partnership with [b][url=https://www.makeship.com/]Makeship[/url][/b]! 

And there will be as [b]many as there is demand[/b]… If you [b]preorder yours[/b] within the next [b]3 weeks[/b]!


[url=https://www.makeship.com/products/lea-plush][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/LeaPlush-Launch-Post-600x600.png[/img][/url]

The plush design (as well as this post’s header art!) was contributed by our dear super talented artist [b][url=https://x.com/YuiKannon]YuiKannon[/url][/b]!
We actually already have a finished real-life sample in our office and can confirm that is indeed smug, smol, and smooshable! It’s also robust, can sit on its own when asked nicely and is complete with horns in the perfect headpat distance (just tested it).

[b][url=https://www.makeship.com/products/lea-plush]PREORDER YOURS AND SUPPORT THE CAMPAIGN![/url][/b]

For people unfamiliar with the Makeship process, you can consult their [b][url=https://www.makeship.com/how-it-works]“How it Works”[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://www.makeship.com/faq]FAQ[/url][/b] pages. In short, each product basically runs a [b]21 days crowdfunding campaign[/b] during which the already designed and prototyped product can be pre-ordered. If the minimum goal ([b]200 units[/b] in our case) is reached, the production will start after the end of the campaign and the goodies will ship 2-4 months later!

Of course every customer will be refunded in case the campaign falls short of its goal. But of course we wanna make it happen, right?

[h1]What else we've been up to[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/Blogpost-25-01-17-header.png[/img]

As we mentioned back in August, we are still working hard on our next big project [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3110760/Alabaster_Dawn/]Alabaster Dawn[/url]. 

Our next big goal will be the release of a [b]public demo[/b] - we initially hoped to have that one ready early this year, but it looks like it will take us a bit longer.

Meanwhile, here a few impressions from recent developments:


[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/aether-get.png[/img]

The [b]first proper dungeon has been completed[/b]! Here are a few examples for the puzzles:
https://bsky.app/profile/gfluegel.radicalfishgames.com/post/3lfs4uf22oc22


Unlike in CrossCode  [b]your companions [/b]actually follow you inside and play a role in solving the puzzles:
https://bsky.app/profile/radicalfishgames.com/post/3lfx7x2mp3k25


And to release some stress you’ll find [b]pots and other objects[/b] to annihilate:
https://bsky.app/profile/regiden.radicalfishgames.com/post/3lfmvjmy5v22m


As you’d expect for a dungeon, you can also receive [b]new abilities[/b] there, of course with a fancy cutscene:
https://bsky.app/profile/radicalfishgames.com/post/3lfitmotnz22a


Aside from the elements and combo attacks, you can also find various [b]Divine Arts[/b] for additional options amongst Juno’s arsenal.
https://bsky.app/profile/lachsen.radicalfishgames.com/post/3lfuokxxndk2x


Finally, a quick look at a [b]crucial cutscene[/b] in a [b]work-in-progress[/b] state with familiar placeholder music.
https://bsky.app/profile/radicalfishgames.com/post/3lez7r3jz7c2g

notes.title: New Action-RPG by Radical Fish Games!
notes.notes:
[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/title-reveal-header-1-600x250.jpg[/img]

Hello everyball!

You may not have heard much from us in the recent years. That's mostly because we've been busy working on our next big project.

Now we're ready to reveal that game with its official name and a trailer!

[previewyoutube=-wRZ-VLAqV8;full][/previewyoutube]

Steam Page: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3110760/Alabaster_Dawn/

Here's the short pitch: 

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/nature-change-1.gif[/img]

Alabaster Dawn is an Action RPG that builds on the best aspects of our previous title, CrossCode. It features a deep combat system, challenging puzzles, and a changing world that will reveal more secrets over time, all bundled up in an engaging story. 

The shadow of Nyx has fallen—warping the world into a wasteland and vanishing the gods and their people. Now, Juno the Outcast Chosen, awakes to an impossible task: bring it all back.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/terra-combat-1.gif[/img]

The game is still [b]in development[/b] but we are working towards releasing a [b]public demo[/b] next year and are planning to go [b]early access[/b] later in 2025, just like we did with CrossCode.

Aaaand that's it! 
If you like what you see, consider wishlisting the game!

notes.title: CrossCode 3rd Anniversary 1.4.2 Update and moving on with Project Terra
notes.notes:
[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/crosscode-anniversary.jpg][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/crosscode-anniversary-600x338.jpg[/img][/url]

Hello, everyball!

On this day, 3 years ago, the [b]1.0.0 full version of CrossCode[/b] was officially released for PC, after years of development and Long-Early-Access. We will celebrate this special occasion with a [b]gift to all our supporters[/b] and also use the chance to give you an update on our next game, [b]Project Terra[/b]!
[h2]CrossCode Version 1.4.2 Release[/h2]
We will be celebrating the 3rd anniversary of [b]CrossCode[/b] with the last proper (non-hotfix..) release, which would be [b]version 1.4.2[/b]!

Luckily it contains almost no new content that we had to actively work on, because the main change would be [b]the removal of the exclusivity of the "Platform-Exclusive Quests"[/b]. That's right, now players on PC can also do the quests that were only available on Switch/XBox/Playstation before, and the same will be true for all the consoles, once the version will be released on them in the near future! Of course this also means that [b]all the related pets[/b] can now be found by everyone!

And as an additional goodie, we also added another [b]Custom Cup[/b] which allows re-fighting battles from those quests with adaptive levels, so even high-level DLC characters with ascended gear are in for a challenge!

Other changes include [b]Combat Arts for an ally[/b] that mysteriously never got any (whoops...), a 5 years overdue fix of a legendary bug regarding [b]music-looping[/b] and some more minor bug fixes, typo fixes and balance tweaks!
[h2]Project Terra[/h2]
Regarding out next project, so far known as [b]Project Terra[/b], we are still working on a playable prototype while also refining our editors and creative vision.

In [url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/?p=7230]a recent post[/url] we also presented the design of our main heroine, [b]Juno[/b]!
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/Juno_annoucement_Artwork-1-600x763.jpg[/img]
(Art by [url=https://twitter.com/nomnomroko]Sibylle Hell[/url])

The reception was very positive and we almost instantly received [url=https://twitter.com/YuiKannon/status/1437834639029145600]amazing[/url] [url=https://twitter.com/wandererKit/status/1438725452315521025]artworks[/url] [url=https://twitter.com/RioleaArt/status/1437884552253427717]by[/url] [url=https://twitter.com/FishyMelon/status/1439111996792729603]fans[/url]!

For now, we're still focusing on getting all the core mechanics worked out. Here's a preview of how things look right now:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wi1tShnt-Lc
If you're curious about our next game, make sure to keep an eye on [url=https://www.radicalfishgames.com/]our blog[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/RadicalFishGame]Twitter[/url], where we'll post most of our progress.
 


And with all that being said, it's time to finally say goodbye to CrossCode after [b]almost 10 years of development[/b].

Thank you so much for supporting us over all those years!

Now, it's time for us to focus on new things!

[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/lea-juno-tag-1.jpg][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/lea-juno-tag-1-600x375.jpg[/img][/url]

Special thanks to [b][url=https://twitter.com/YuiKannon]YuiKannon[/url][/b], who has done many CrossCode-fanarts in the past, for drawing those amazing artwork of this post! You'll likely see more art from her in the future on our blog!

notes.title: CrossCode x Quantum Protocol Collab
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/header-1-600x328.jpg[/img]

Hello everyball!

Starting today, you will find the cast of CrossCode in (yet) another indie game: the deckbuilding card game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1328530?utm_source=collab&utm_campaign=crosscode]Quantum Protocol[/url]! For the occasion, we also release another hotfix for CrossCode, adding bunch of fixes, a tiny bit of content, as well as a small group of guest characters!

[h2]CrossCode x Quantum Protocol[/h2]

With today's update, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1328530?utm_source=collab&utm_campaign=crosscode]Quantum Protocol[/url] will include a whole set of new cards featuring several [b]CrossCode characters[/b] as well as the [b]four elements[/b] for you to use!

https://youtu.be/bWF_FiAiDK4

Here is an overview of all newly added cards:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/cards-600x443.png[/img]

Those cards work in a unique way reflecting the mechanics of CrossCode. You can read more about it in [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1328530/view/3094513593453845797"]this blog post[/url]

You can get Quantum Protocol on Steam here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1328530?utm_source=collab&utm_campaign=crosscode


[h2]Hotfix version 1.4.1-3[/h2]

We released another hotfix, mostly fixing bugs and spelling issues. There's also a few small content additions, including:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/arena-supporters-cup-600x338.png[/img]
A new [b]Supporters' Cup[/b] to be found among the [b]custom cups[/b], adding a few more quest related boss battles to the arena.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/item-top-600x338.png[/img]
A new room [b]above the Rhombus Square Item Shop[/b] assembling a whole bunch of traders for all kind of items.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/quantum-protocol-characters.png[/img]
A couple of [b]guest characters from Quantum Protocol[/b] just vibing in a certain inn. Have fun finding them! Unfortunately, with no new dialogs this time.

And that's it!

Meanwhile, the [b]CrossCode New Home DLC[/b] is currently being ported to consoles and we'll let you know once a release date is certain.

And otherwise, we're all hard at work on [b]Project Terra[/b], currently working on a lot of things, including a new animations system:

https://twitter.com/lachsen/status/1388218721433493505

We'll likely create another post about Project Terra in the future, showing things a bit more in detail.

And that's all for today! Until next time!

notes.title: CrossCode: Introducing a New Skin!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/manlea-header-600x263.png[/img]

Hello everyball!

CrossCode is finally complete! [b]Or is it[/b]?

As some of you might remember, we introduced you to a certain someone, exactly [url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/?p=3345]6 years ago[/url].

Now guess who's back?
<!--more-->
[h2]Manlea is here![/h2]

Playing as Lea is great and all, but some of you might miss an option for a protagonist who simply is... [b]manlier[/b].

That's why we proudly present to you, once again: 

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/manlea-600x418.png[/img]

Only this time [b]Manlea is real[/b]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/manlea-menu-600x338.png[/img]
You can play CrossCode, being [b]Manlea[/b].

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/manlea-battle2-600x338.png[/img]
You can beat up enemies, being [b]Manlea[/b].

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/manlea-dialog4-600x338.png[/img]
You can talk to other characters, being [b]Manlea[/b]*.

*Keep in mind that Manlea is still Lea, but manlier. She's still referred to as Lea and with she/her pronouns (a.k.a. we didn't adapt any dialogs).

Manlea is now available as a [b]Skin DLC[/b] on both Steam and GOG!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1585790]Get Manlea on Steam[/url]
[url=https://www.gog.com/game/crosscode_manlea]Get Manlea on GOG[/url]

This is [b]no April's Fools joke[/b].
This is [b]real[/b].

Today just happens to be [url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/?p=3345]Manlea's 6 years anniversary[/url].

With all that being said: 

[b]Have fun being Manlea in CrossCode[/b]!

Also: if you now, for some reason, feel like screaming at us, we'll be available in another [b]gamedev stream[/b] this [b]Saturday 20:00 CEST / 11am PDT[/b] on [url=https://twitch.tv/radicalfishgames]our Twitch Channel[/url]

notes.title: One last Update for CrossCode: A New Home!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/version-up-1.4.1-600x349.jpg[/img]

Hello everyball!

So... we're not entirely done yet! Today we'll release another [b]small update[/b] for the DLC [b]Crosscode: A New Home[/b], adding a bit of more optional content!

<!--more-->

[h2]What's New?[/h2]

This update includes a bit of optional content that we originally hoped to released a month ago, but didn't quite manage to finish in time. 

Version [b]1.4.1[/b] includes [b]3 quests[/b] as well as a couple of [b]arena cups[/b] and new [b]Trade Offers[/b] in Rhombus Square. 

Note that the new content is part of the [b]A New Home[/b] DLC and not included in the main game.

Here a few impressions of what's included:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/post-update-1-600x338.png[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/post-update-2-600x338.png[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/post-update-3-600x338.png[/img]

Actual boss enemies can be properly seen in the game!

This update is pretty much the [b]final content addition[/b] to CrossCode! With following releases we only plan to fix remaining bugs and issues.

That means, after over 9 years of development, CrossCode has finally been [b]completed[/b]!

[h2]What about CrossCode 2?[/h2]

We noticed that several players are now counting on a [b]sequel[/b] to be developed, especially due to a certain cutscene in [b]A New Home[/b].

We sort of regret adding that cutscene, because the truth is:
[b]Right now, there are no plans for a sequel to CrossCode.[/b]

We definitely had a great time working on this title and see the world and its characters grow. 
But after 9 whole years, we are ready to work on something new.

[h2]Our Next Game[/h2]

We're currently in the [b]prototyping phase[/b] for our next game.

That games doesn't have a proper name yet, but it does have a temporary [b]project title[/b]:

[b]Project Terra[/b]

Project Terra will be an Action-RPG, with a gameplay mix similar to CrossCode, featuring a new setting and story line!

Here are a few impressions you might have seen recently on twitter:

https://twitter.com/teflorator/status/1336536291396161536

https://twitter.com/ThomasFroese/status/1376868521024573441

https://twitter.com/teflorator/status/1376981558964408322

https://twitter.com/lachsen/status/1346589705052299270

https://twitter.com/RadicalRegiden/status/1352623637715705857

It doesn't look much like a game yet, but we'll get there! Right now, we're mostly working on [b]tools[/b].

We'll talk more about the new project within the next few months.

But for now, a short disclaimer:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/BMVI_Foerderlogo_englisch_NEU-600x603.jpg[/img]

That's right! The state of Germany is financially supporting the development of the Project Terra prototype! Yay! [strike]Tax money well spend.[/strike]

So yeah, expect more, hopefully exciting news soon!

Until then!

notes.title: CrossCode: A New Home - Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/dlc-release-header-600x338.jpg[/img]

And here it finally is! After another 2 years, we have finally released the last content extension of CrossCode!

The DLC [b]CrossCode: A New Home[/b] is now available on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1517030/CrossCode_A_New_Home/]Steam[/url] and [url=https://www.gog.com/game/crosscode_a_new_home]GOG[/url], currently for [b]10% off[/b]!
If you don't own the [b]main game[/b] yet, there is also currently a sale for [b]half the price[/b]!

That's really a lot of game for not all that much!
[h2]For Indiegogo Backers[/h2]
Since the early supporters on Indiegogo made the development of CrossCode possible in the first place, we decided to make [b]the DLC a perk of the original "Game" tier (and above)[/b] for our [b]Indiegogo backers[/b].
You'll find the DLC on [url=http://central.cross-code.com]CrossCentral[/url] (there might be a slight delay with the upload).
[h2]What's in the DLC[/h2]
Here is what CrossCode: A New Home has to offer:
[list]
 	[*]A playtime of about [b]8-15 hours[/b][/*]
 	[*][b]Ku'lero Temple[/b]: Probably the biggest dungeon we've ever created[/*]
 	[*]Fight against several enemies, including [b]over 10 new bosses[/b][/*]
 	[*]Run over water for the very first time in the new area [b]Azure Archipelago[/b][/*]
 	[*]Tackle [b]8 new optional quests[/b] with unique mechanics and scenarios[/*]
 	[*]Listen to [b]3 new music tracks[/b] composed by [url=https://steelplus.xyz/]はがね/STEEL_PLUS[/url][/*]
 	[*]Unlock new Arena Cups and Bonus CP to fully upgrade your circuit tree![/*]
 	[*]And of course: [b]Finish the raid![/b][/*]
[/list]
Note: All the new content of the DLC is playable after the end of the main game. There is no reason to restart from the beginning - [b]you can continue with your old save[/b].
[h2]CrossCode Original Soundtrack EX[/h2]
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/ost-cover-600x330.png[/img]

If you enjoy the new music of the DLC and want to support our composers, you can also buy the new [b]CrossCode Original Soundtrack EX[/b] on [url=https://interovgm.com/album/crosscode-original-soundtrack-ex]Bandcamp[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1517040]Steam[/url], [url=https://www.gog.com/game/crosscode_original_soundtrack_ex]GOG[/url], and [url=https://distrokid.com/hyperfollow/denizakbulutandhagane/crosscode-original-game-soundtrack-ex]other music platforms[/url] as well!

This soundtrack features not only the new tracks of the DLC, but also a number of more recent CrossCode tracks that didn't make it into the first soundtrack, as well as a selection of old tracks from the early demos and Early Access versions.
[h2]State of Localizations[/h2]
Since we're entirely hopeless with scheduling, we ended up adding too much text content just days before the release. Our localization partners did their best to translate the new content as fast as possible, but still, [b]the localizations might not be 100% complete[/b] by the time of the release. Just to be clear: If you see any untranslated text (which will mostly be for quests and other optional content) - that's because we added the content way too recently! We're sorry!

The good news is: we're all working on the localization at this very moment and will update the game as soon as it's completed - this will hopefully happen within a week.
[h2]How to play the DLC[/h2]
The DLC will [b]extend[/b] the story of CrossCode. So in order to play it, you need to [b]finish the main story of CrossCode first[/b] - and you'll need to get the [b]good ending[/b].

You've reached the good ending when the final screen looks like this:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/meta-space-600x338.png[/img]

However, when the right side of that screen is [b]red[/b], you got the [b]bad ending[/b]. Don't worry! You can get to the good ending very quickly by going to the left and replaying the final part of the game. You can even [b]skip[/b] the last battles, dungeon, and boss fights.

Here's a more detailed guide (with an obvious [b]spoiler warning[/b]):


[spoiler]In the Meta Space, go to the left to be set back in time

Teleport to [b]Rhombus Square - South Arch[/b]

Go down the stairs in the [b]south east[/b], then to the [b]east[/b] entering [b]Lloyd Passage[/b] and keep running further to the [b]east[/b]

At this point, you might spot [b]Albert[/b] sitting in a cafe in the [b]south east of Lloyd Passage[/b]

Walk to Albert and talk to him! From this point on, the game will give you clear instructions on what to do next.

Make sure you convince Albert's friend in the following meeting!

If you want, you can safely skip the following raid of Vermillion Wasteland, the final dungeon and the final boss fight to get right to the ending.

If you did everything right, you'll get the good ending and can start playing CrossCode: A New Home!
[/spoiler]

[h2]A New Home with New Game Plus[/h2]
CrossCode: A New Home is fully compatible with NG+ saves. Certain NG+ options such as [b]Sergey Hacks[/b] might even slightly change the game's dialog. However, keep in mind that playing the game with certain NG+ options might impact the overall difficulty and entirely negate any sort of challenge.

We recommend playing the DLC with a regular save first!
[h2]Bugs, Crashes and Worse[/h2]
This DLC is our first major release since a [b]very long time[/b]. Please keep in mind that, as with any major release, things might not be entirely stable yet. There will be bugs.

We did a lot of testing and had a very long beta phase prior to the release. However, from experience we know that there will always be issues left that we missed.
That's why we'll be set and ready to patch things up as quick as possible, at least for the next week or two!

Hopefully, nothing critically bad will happen. But if you want to be extra sure, we [b]recommend keeping a save from the end of the main game[/b].

And that's all! Have fun with the DLC! We hope you enjoy the extended story, new battles, and puzzles!

Until next time!

notes.title: Finally some more CrossCode News!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/highlight-20-10-14-600x334.png[/img]

Hello everyball!

It has been a long time and we're finally back with a new update! We have news about the console versions as well as some words about the Post Game DLC release date.

[h2]Next steps for CrossCode on Consoles[/h2]

CrossCode on consoles had a somewhat rocky release with a number of performance issues (especially on Switch). Luckily, most of the major issues have been fixed rather quickly! Unfortunately the certification of the patches for the different consoles took longer. At the time of writing, one patch is still in certification for the PlayStation 4. But we’re getting there. Work on following updates continues of course.

The next bigger update however will take a little longer. We have finally started on migrating to the latest build which means that we are also working on [b]New Game Plus[/b] for the consoles. Due to the nature of how CrossCode runs on consoles (HTML5 inside a C++ application) this will take some time, as it requires additional testing of previously not included features. We are still quite optimistic to unleash the patch in 2020. But if you ask us for a specific date: No, we can't tell you when exactly NG+ is ready for consoles. But it will happen!

As you may already know, in celebration of the CrossCode release for consoles, we teamed up with ININ Games to give you a special [b]limited SteelBook release and a really nice Collector's Edition![/b] These two special non-retail versions of CrossCode are available for pre-order exclusively at the SLG Partner Store.

The Nintendo Switch Collector’s Edition is currently sold out, but there are still some couple of hundred copies of the SteelBook Edition left. The even more limited in numbers PS4 Editions are still available, both in the form of a Collector’s Edition - Limited to 1500 copies worldwide - and a PS4 SteelBook Edition.  

All editions feature a sequential numbering, an individual number for each and every copy of the game, which shows off it’s exclusive nature in a really cool way! These editions will also feature a different (and reversible!) cover art than the regular retail version of the game. 

Besides the console editions, we also have some good news for our PC fans. We are very happy that CrossCode will be given a physical PC release! As this version won’t be widely available at retail, the way to go if you’d like to own a PC copy of CrossCode will be to get it through the SLG Partner Store! The CrossCode PC Editions will be available as a SteelBook Edition, as well as a Collector’s Edition.

[h2]Next steps for the Post Game DLC[/h2]

Work on the DLC continues! Here are few new impressions:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/beach-wip-600x338.png[/img]
More progress on the new area! Things are still work in progress here!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/unkown-location-600x338.png[/img]
A new location in the sky?

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/sergey-is-back-600x338.png[/img]
Look who is now in the game!

Now a little word about the [b]release windows[/b]

In our last update we already mentioned that the release of the DLC will happen "hopefully this year".
Since the console release was more distracting for us than expected and also because we keep underestimating the amount of work ahead, we'd like to move the release window a little bit further.

The new plan is to release the post-game DLC in [b]early 2021[/b].

We know this is a bummer for many - initially we aimed to release the DLC in time for the second anniversary of the PC release.

However, ultimately we want to make sure that the quality of the DLC will match the rest of the game and for that we'll need a bit more time to bring the whole story to a (hopefully) satisfying conclusion.

Just remember: more time usually means a better result. That's why we had to postpone CrossCode 6 times before this already.

We are sorry for the delay but also hope you understand.
It will be worth the wait!

Until next time!

notes.title: Modding Shoutout: Autumn's Genesis
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/inferno-full-600x480.png[/img]

Hello everyball!

With the CrossCode console release about to happen we're now writing about something entirely different: [b]CrossCode Modding projects[/b]

[h2]CrossCode Modding[/h2]

To be frank: we never really designed CrossCode with modding in mind. But yet, it still happened - maybe because the JavaScript code base makes the game fairly accessible. 
For several years now we've been watching a couple of smaller and larger modding projects appear over time. However, now is the first time the modding community actively organizes a whole event, so we thought we could help with a little shoutout.

If you are interested in the modding community in general, feel free to visit their [url=https://discord.gg/TFs6n5v]Discord Server[/url]

However, before you continue installing and playing mods:

[h2]Important Disclaimer for CrossCode Mods[/h2]

Modding projects are [b]unofficial content[/b] and as such, we [b]won't be able to help you[/b] with any issue that may arise from installing and playing mods for CrossCode.

Be aware that installing mods can [b]potentially break your save data[/b], so it's recommended to [b]back up your saves[/b] before installing any modding project. 

One option to back up your saves:
[list]
[*]Start CrossCode and load the save you want to backup[/*]
[*]Pressing F10[/*]
[*]Save the text of the upper field into a text file[/*]
[/list]

To import your save file again:
[list]
[*]Start CrossCode and press F10[/*]
[*]Insert the text of your save backup in the lower text field and press Submit[/*]
[*]Your imported save will be the [b]last save[/b] in your list of saves[/*]
[/list]

Now that we got that out of the way, let's talk events!

[h2]Autumn's Genesis - Master Trials Score Attack![/h2] 

Since last week you can participate in a very special challenge, taking on [b]very strong variants of the game's boss fights[/b] and try to get the best score!

Here's how that will look like:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/ezgif.com-video-to-gif_1-1.gif[/img]

If this sounds exciting to you, you will find all the necessary information here:

[url=https://c2dl.info/cc/news/2]Autumns Genesis Installation Guide and Rules for Participation[/url] 

The event will last until [b]September 1st[/b], so there's still plenty of time.

And that's pretty much it!

Depending on how things go, we might be giving more shoutouts to other CrossCode modding projects in the future. Until then, feel free to join the modding community and maybe start modding yourself!

Until next time!

notes.title: [Insert Platform Name Here] When?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8768797/c893490f0f3f11b0623859bb05a479eb4c3d21ce.jpg[/img]

Hello everyball!

... Deck13 writing here today. We're the publisher of CrossCode. We're also handling the port to other platforms at the very moment. And all of us, here at Deck13, over at RFG, over at Nintendo, Sony and Microsoft hear your questions. Which is basically always the same: When? When will CrossCode finally be coming to consoles?

[h1]WHEN???[/h1]

The answer is: Sooner than you might think. We are ready to announce an official date very soon. Maybe next week? We wanted to let you know that we will be revealing the official release date for the console version of CrossCode next Tuesday. And we always said that once we announce the releasedate, the wait will even sooner be over. This means: You won't have to wait much longer. But we can't go into details just yet.

[h1]What took you so long?[/h1]

CrossCode was build in a custom engine written in HTML5 and JavaScript. Something which the consoles do not really support well. We had to create a compiler for it, translating everything into C++ before the game loads up. Because live compiling, which JavaScript does, is not allowed on most platforms as it opens up ways to access the deeper cores of the hardware. We even had to restart the whole process once as the first way we were going for did not work out as intended. We had to throw away roughly one year of work and start all over again.

[h1]But...[/h1]

No fear. We did our homework. CrossCode has passed all console certifications. And we're still submitting patches to the version which passed certifications. These will be available from Day 1 and your version will automatically be updated to the latest build.

[h1]Anything else[/h1]

Oh yeah, while we're at it: We have decided to bundle CrossCode on Steam with a fresh product we just launched, called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/975150/Resolutiion/]Resolutiion[/url]. We think it might be something you could enjoy as you're all fans of gorgeous pixelart.

notes.title: CrossCode 1.2.0-5 - New NW.js version + SteelSeries Engine Support
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/version-up-1.2.0-5-1-600x349.jpg[/img]

Hello everyball,

as we announced a few weeks back, we finally follow up with the small promised technical update of CrossCode! With version 1.2.0-5 we update NW.js to a newer version and also add basic support for the SteelSeries Engine.

[h1]NW.js Version update[/h1]

With this version, CrossCode now runs with NW.js version [b]0.35.5[/b], which hopefully fixes some of the memory leak issue several players have reported on [b]Windows[/b], as well as crashing issues on [b]Linux[/b] and [b]OSX[/b]. If you have issues with the new version (or past issues remain), please let us know via E-Mail (contact@radicalfishgames.com) or in the Steam Forum.

For users of the nwjs_old branch, things stay the same.

[h1]SteelSeries Engine 3 Support[/h1]

[b]SteelSeries Engine 3[/b] is a tool that let's you adjust all the funky periphery that SteelSeries has to offer. It also doubles as a kind of local server, allowing applications to register themselves as "Games" and illuminate your hardware. SteelSeries asked us to integrate this into CrossCode and being avid [u]gamers[/u] ourselves the only logical answer was to say "yes". 
All jokes aside, what this means is that we can highlight certain keys on your keyboard based on in-game context. We are currently supporting all Steel Series Keyboards that have [b]Per-Key-Lightning[/b]. 

[url=http://steelseri.es/crosscodekb]List of supported keyboards[/url].
[url=http://steelseri.es/crosscodeeng]Download for SteelSeries Engine 3 / Gamesense[/url]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/game-sense-option-600x338.png[/img]
Once [b]Game Sense is activated in the options menu of CrossCode[/b] your function keys will turn into a Health-Bar, while the number keys will light-up to the corresponding element. Future updates might extend this feature as players request cool stuff or we come up with more ideas. 

Big thanks to SteelSeries who provided us with the hardware and tech support to implement this.



And that's all for this update! Sorry for the lack of new content, but as we mentioned before: new things are being worked on! Expect more in 2020!

Until next time!

notes.title: Upcoming Updates, DLC and Console Versions!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/highlight-19-12-02-600x334.png[/img]

Hello everyball!

Quite some time has passed since the last Update so we wanted to let you know what we've been working on recently and what Updates you can expect next!

[h1]Recent Progress and upcoming Updates[/h1]

With the Newgame+ Feature completed we're now focusing our work on the [b]Post Game DLC[/b] that will add a little Epilogue to the current end of CrossCode. Among other things it will feature things like an [b]extended Rhombus Square[/b], [b]more Quests[/b], and a [b]proper Final Dungeon[/b]. And also a few answers to some of the questions you might still have at the end of CrossCode's story. 

Here's a screenshot without context to give you a little something:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/some-village-600x338.png[/img]

We don't have a release date for the Post Game DLC yet, as it will still take some time to develop. We're currently targeting Q2, 2020.

As we're currently focused on the DLC, we unfortunately don't have a lot of content ready for regular game update. However, you can expect an upcoming [b]technical update in the next 1-2 weeks[/b], as we plan to update [b]NW.js[/b], the software/engine we use to run CrossCode. We hope that this will fix some of the Crash issues people experience on Linux as well as Memory Leaks on Windows. There will also be a little feature added to that, but more on that later!

Now, a lot of you were most likely waiting for something else from CrossCode this years... those [b]console versions[/b]!

As our Publisher [b]Deck13 Spotlight[/b] is working on the port, here's a short message from them about how things are going:

[h1]CrossCode for Consoles when?[/h1]

Greetings everyball,

Michael here from Deck13. Publisher of CrossCode and the folks who are porting the game to consoles. And yes, we’ve been reading your tweets. Your posts on reddit. Your messages on Facebook. The outcalls on Discord. And we’re pretty sure there have been some Tik Tok videos, too. And as promised via Twitter, we’ll talk about the state of the [b]console versions[/b] a bit. Also Switch, yes.

First of all: We’re still working on it and we’re making really good progress. That being said, we hoped for a 2019 release earlier this year. And – as you can see – this did not work out as intended. We underestimated the amount of work a bit. Or, in other words, it became... complicated. Especially the performance became a major challenge. Lea would say: [b]Why[/b]?

That’s why: CrossCode is written in HTML5. And that means that there is tons of JavaScript. And live compiling it in a Chromium Browser is causing security issues on consoles and is forbidden on most platforms as hackers could attack the hardware through that. So we had to find a solution. Which is basically an interpreter which translates the code but locks it up in a cage. That also means: We had a performance bottleneck. As the code was read by the interpreter and then translated into something the console would understand and then read by the console. It is like watching a movie in a movie in a livestream. Yet: We have it under control now. We’re still ironing out the last issues, fixing some broken bosses and quests (which also have to be interpreted which means the interpreter must be able to read them etc.). But we’re getting there.

More details can be found in this video, where Robert, who is working on the interpreter, is sharing some details: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KfBzlzvt8RU

Sadly, Lea isn’t able to say the word [b]where[/b] yet. But the question would be: Where are we at right now? We are currently focusing on testing the [b]Xbox One[/b] version of CrossCode. If everything works out as intended, this should be the last major playthrough. We’re hunting the last performance killers, the last broken quests, the last weird behaving enemies. We are close to the first submission. We are already in the optional submissions. Yes, it runs (most times, but we’re working on that) at 60 FPS by now. And yes, it plays as fluid as on PC.

[b]How[/b]? How can we not mention [b]Switch[/b]. Well, we’re doing it now: We’re focusing on the Xbox right now for no specific reason but just to focus on one platform. Technically, with the way the interpreter is working, the step to other platforms is rather easy from there. Okay, for the Switch we need to do some further optimization, but that’s, compared to the rest, just some minor stuff. After that we’ll “just” need to pass the certifications.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/ccswitchgif.gif[/img]

When will CrossCode release on consoles? We’ll announce that once we have a fixed date set. Expect an announcement on a rather short notice here as we are, obviously, also in discussions with the platform holders about that. To shorten the wait, we’ve prepared a small trailer for now:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FF1y3ff2AVw

Thanks. Bye, Michael, Bye.

-----

And that's all from our side as well!

You'll most likely hear from us one more time this year. Until then!

notes.title: CrossCode 1.2 - New Game+ is out!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/version-up-1.2-1-600x349.jpg[/img]

Greetings everyball,

the time for [b]version 1.2[/b] has finally arrived! And with it come [b]new arena content[/b] and, of course, [b]the New Game Plus[/b]!

[h1]New Game Plus is out![/h1]
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/title-new-game-select.png[/img]

The long promised [b]New Game Plus[/b] is finally available! And it packs a ton of options that can modify your playthrough for additional challenge, experiments or pure silly fun. As long as you have earned enough [b]Trophy Points[/b] to unlock them!

For additional challenge you can, for example, increase the damage you receive and the cooldown of your consumables, give enemies (including bosses!) more challenging attack patterns or reduce the effect of the popular HP Regeneration.

For perfectionist gamers there is even a mode that has poor Lea [b]die after just one hit[/b]...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/newgame-witchtime.gif[/img]
Dashing experts and fans of fancy witches can also activate [b]Witch Time,[/b] which (heh...) will slow down time whenever you execute a Perfect Dodge!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/newgame-sergey-hax.gif[/img]
And if you just want a fun time as an all-powerful avatar of destruction you can activate [b]Sergey Hax[/b] and deal ridiculous damage with every attack.

Of course it'll also be possible to [b]transfer your progress[/b] from the old game into the new one, like items, levels, botanics and more.

These are not even all of the modifications you can use. You better take your time to check it out yourself to craft your unique kind of CrossCode experience!

Lastly, some of those options, like Sergey Hax or keeping your old level, will also trigger a few [b]special changes to the game's dialogue[/b]. Certain suspicions may seem very justified all of the sudden...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/newgame-plus-dialogs-2-600x338.png[/img]
[h1]New Arena Content[/h1]
As for the game itself, [b]three more cups[/b] are now available in the Arena of Rhombus Square:

[b]Faction Rookie Cup[/b], [b]Faction Advanced Cup[/b] and [b]Faction Team Cup[/b].

As the names imply, those cups center around revisiting battles from the quests that you have solved for the Factions of Shadoon. How well can you handle them at a high level, with top scores on the line?

Of course to access the cups you will first need to solve all the quests related to the fights.

With 3 more cups and their precious Arena Coins being available, the Arena Shop has extended its offers as well. You can now also find [b]4 pieces of unique equipment[/b] and also [b]3 precious pets[/b]. Ever wanted to have Death itself under your command?

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/lil-reaper.gif[/img]

Well, it won't really help you here but it makes for a cute companion, doesn't it?

 

And that's it for this update! Have fun with the new content and look forward to more in the future!

Until next time!

notes.title: Upcoming Update 1.2: New Game Plus!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8768797/254d7661214e91b30ca413dc7629c07cc5369725.png[/img]

It's been almost 2 months since our [url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/?p=6772]1.1 Release[/url], so we thought it's due time for another update. Let's jump right into it!

[h1]Version 1.2[/h1]
Version 1.2 will include a feature that was a stretch goal in our [url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/crosscode#/]IndieGogo campaign back in 2015[/url]: [b]New Game Plus[/b]. As such we didn't just wanted to let you replay the game and keep all your stuff. We wanted to add more options for players to customize their playthrough with different options. And we actually laid down the groundwork for this pretty early on. Remember that trophies had a value attached to them? Yes, they did! And they weren't for show.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8768797/cbc2070103d2d6642c558283dfe80bf009847795.png[/img]
Once you have a save file with a clear mark (this little star under the level display) selecting [b]New Game[/b] from the title menu will now prompt this little selection. Selecting the right hand option lets you use your combined trophy points to customize your game! How? Well there are a lot of options...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8768797/4d2b86a12f9bb002ce05142e2f0609ff6a8409e1.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8768797/518db1718e77149f08e76b21ee7b6f7a59ba21fb.png[/img]

These here are just some of the options you have, but as you can see we do feature the usual culprits like carrying over items or increasing EXP/Money. However more unique modifiers are also on the table which can alter the gameplay quite drastically.
Combining different combat modifiers and enemy related options can make the game very challenging or make you insanely overpowered. The choice here is yours!

Here's a little example of what happens when combining [b]Dash Master[/b] and [b]Witch Time[/b]:
https://giant.gfycat.com/BlankSkeletalAlligatorgar.webm
(sorry for the bare link, the clip got a bit too long :P)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8768797/551b9cb9cab1b31ae1d2bcee359aa7938ce5a2e9.png[/img]

Selecting any option from the [b]Carry-Over[/b] group will let you select a clear file that will be used to import items, levels and so on. And yes this means, that by importing saves you can quickly jump into new game plus too! Just in case someone needs it!

[h1]Release Date[/h1]
Content wise most of the features we wanted to implemented are already implemented (in fact only 3 of 42 are currently still WIP). We want to push the update to our internal beta testers very soon and make sure everything is sound. Since we are also including new dialogs (and maybe even quests) in the update it will takes a tiny bit more time to really test all of it. Because of this [b]we can't give you an exact date on the 1.2 release[/b]. But we do our best to get it done as soon as possible, pinky promise!

[h1]Other Stuff[/h1]
The last couple of weeks our team was busy visiting some events and also having a big trip to Japan so we took that time to unwind a bit and relaxed.
But that doesn’t mean we didn’t work on other CrossCode related stuff! It's just content we don't want to share just yet to not spoil the surprise.

Alright, that's it for this update! Until next time!

notes.title: CrossCode's 1.1 update gives you critter companions
notes.notes:
Retro sci-fi RPG CrossCode has been bolstered by a big update today, chucking in new quests, S-rank battles, an arena and, more important than any of that, loyal pets who will follow you around on your adventures. CrossCode's already a huge game—and pretty great—but there's always room for pooches. 

Dogs are far too precious to fling into battle, of course, so don't expect your pets to get stuck into the extremely brisk real-time combat. They'll just hang back and give you moral support. Remember to thank them once you've killed your enemies. 

Next to the pets, the most notable addition is the Rhombus Square Arena. Inside, you'll be able to arrange fights against regular enemies, dungeon enemies and bosses. Each cup contains multiple rounds, either taken on individually or in a rush mode where you do the cup in one go. Medals you win can be exchanged for coins that can in turn be spent on new gear, decorative stuff and pets. The extra step seems a bit unnecessary.  

The new combat rank makes enemies respawn faster, so you can try to get longer combat streaks, while the turret defence mini-game now includes a challenge mode and, yes, more rewards. 

CrossCode 1.1 is available now. There's also a demo on Steam if you're in the market for a new RPG.

notes.title: CrossCode 1.0.3-3 – SPEED LINES
notes.notes:

In order to fix this issue, we added [b]SPEED LINES[/b]!

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/faster-gameplay-600x338.png[/img]
Pictured: Improved CrossCode gameplay with speed lines for a faster and superior experience.

We also made a few trees more regular.

For now, the new Hotfix release is only available through Steam.

EDIT: 
[b]Happy April Fools' Day[/b]! 

Yeah, that last update may have overdone it a bit with speed lines.
With today's update speed lines have been reduced to only appear in important combat events (because it's actually cool that way).

If you actually miss having speed lines on every move, you can still use the [b]Speedlines[/b] bonus code to enable them!

Same for the [b]Regular-Trees[/b].

notes.notes:
[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/version-up-1.0.3-600x349.jpg[/img]

Hello everyball! It's time for another CrossCode update! Version 1.0.3 adds a couple new quests, more NPC dialogs and a few small details here and there.

[h1]New Quests[/h1]

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/dkar-final-quest-600x338.png[/img]

With this version we fulfill our long-standing promise to finally conclude "A Promise is a Promise" quest line! And here it is, complete with a [b]new boss fight[/b] and a fair bit of plot development! Have a look around [b]Rhombus Square[/b] and you might spot D'kar in a [b]new building[/b] you can enter!

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/lmh-headquarters-inner-600x338.png[/img]

In other news: The [b]Last Minute Heroes[/b] guild headquarters is finally [b]open to everyone[/b]! And they even have a quest for you! However, you'll actually find that one in [b]Sapphire Ridge[/b] towards the end of the game. Check out the [b]bulletin board in the Cave Inn[/b]!

[h1]More NPC Dialogs + More[/h1]

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/new-npcs-bergen-600x338.png[/img]

All the NPC dialogs of the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/368340/announcements/detail/3168746441720712191]recent contest[/url] have been implemented, so now you can finally find out what they have to say! 

You might also notice that a [b]new consumable item[/b] is dropped by the [b]Moon bugs[/b] in Sapphire Ridge - you'll also find it in the Backer Store of Rookie Harbor.

And finally, if you'd like to see Lea acting out a very, very dated meme, try the new [b]Caramelldansen[/b] bonus code.

Have fun!

[h1]Next Steps[/h1]
Now the time as come to tackle the big features! We recently started with the implementation of the [b]Arena[/b] in Rhombus Square, which will include a multitude of combat challenges including of course a [b]boss rush mode[/b]! We'll post a few more details about it soon. For now, have a WIP screenshot of the [b]Cup selection menu[/b]:

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/arena-600x338.png[/img]

Another feature we'll work on next is the [b]New Game+ mode [/b] that will allow you to replay the game with certain aspects changed. What aspects exactly? More about this in the next blog post!

Both the Arena and New Game+ modes are part of our new [b]milestone[/b] for version 1.0.4 that we hope to release in [b]April 2019[/b]. Of course, it will also come with [b]more quests[/b], NPCs and other things.

Until next time!

notes.title: Ninja Skin DLC + About that Switch version
notes.notes:
[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/ninja-skin-header-600x301.jpg[/img]

Hello everyball!

We have another quick update for you, since today we release a [b]little DLC[/b] to the public and also we'd like to have a word about a [b]Switch version[/b].

[h1]Ninja Skin DLC released[/h1]

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/ninja-menu-600x338.png[/img]

The Ninja DLC is now available on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/960310/CrossCode__Ninja_Skin/]Steam[/url]! Use it to give Lea a stealthy ninja outfit. You can see it when moving around, during battle, and even in the menu screen!

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/ninja-run.gif[/img]
I mean, she already runs like a ninja, so it was obvious we had to add this skin eventually.

Some background: The Ninja skin was one of the rewards for our Indiegogo backers and has been available for them for a few months already. We decided to release it on Steam a bit later, to keep it exclusive for our backers at least for some time.

[h1]About that Switch version[/h1]

For quite some time now we've received [i]a number of[/i] requests from people asking us to port CrossCode to one [b]particular platform[/b].

Everyday single day.

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/switch-asking-600x275.jpg[/img]

Yes, we heard you. You want to play [b]CrossCode[/b] on your [b]Switch[/b].
We get where you're coming from. Our game has been inspired by so many Nintendo classics, so it would feel right at home on the Switch. And obviously, it would be amazing to play CrossCode on the go. 

However, the reality is this: porting CrossCode to Switch is really difficult. As some of you might be aware, CrossCode is written in HTML5 which you cannot run natively on the Switch (just like most consoles). This means a LOT of things have to be reprogrammed/rewritten. And this is especially challenging on the Switch which doesn't provide the hardware capabilities of other current-gen consoles. That's why we still can't make any promise!

Now... We've given this answer many, many times. But who knows, maybe it's too technical and that's why people just won't stop asking so we'll simplify it a bit:

[b]Sorry but CrossCode will be coming to Switch when Hedgehags learn to fly.[/b]

Anyway, this is now our answer to all those Switch requests for the time being!
You can keep asking if you want (and you probably will). The answer will be the same.

Anyway, that's all for now! Until next time!

notes.title: NPC Dialog Contest + We won an award!
notes.notes:
[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/npc-contest-dialog-600x338.jpg[/img]

Hello everyball!

The year 2018 is coming to a close, but before it ends we have a little [b]competition[/b] for you! Also, we won an [b]award[/b]!

[h1]NPC Dialog Contest[/h1]

You may have noticed that CrossCode is filled to the brim with NPCs! You may also have noticed that a lot of them... just stand there and don't even say anything. With this competition we plan to change this!

[b]How to participate:[/b]

[list]
[*]Find a [b]single NPC[/b] or a [b]group of NPCs[/b] in the game that are missing dialog[/*]
[*]Write a fitting dialog in [b]English[/b]! Make sure to specify if it's a [b]Regular Dialog[/b] or [b]Xeno Dialog[/b] (more: read below)[/*]
[*]Send the dialog + a screenshot of the NPC(s) to [url=mailto:contest@radicalfishgames.com]contest@radicalfishgames.com[/url][/*]
[*]Each participant can only submit [b]one dialog[/b]![/*]
[/list]

[b]Deadline: December 16 11:59pm PST[/b]


[b]What to win:[/b]

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/ost-price-600x294.png[/img]

[b]The 5 best submissions[/b] will win a [b]physical CrossCode Soundtrack[/b] sponsored by [url=https://firstpressgames.com]First Press Games[/url]!
[b]The 20 best submissions[/b] will be [b]implemented into the game[/b] with an optional [b]credits entry[/b]!

[b]Dialog Types[/b]

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/dialog-types-600x173.jpg[/img]

There are two ways to write dialogs:
[b]Regular Dialog[/b]: The player needs to explicitly interact with the NPC to start the conversation. This fits best for [b]single NPCs[/b]

[b]Xeno Dialogs:[/b] Speech bubbles will appear over the NPCs when you move close to them. Those work best for [b]group of NPCs[/b] that talk with each other independent of the player.

Optionally, you can also switch from a "Xeno Dialog" to a "Regular Dialog". This usually happens, when Lea wants to comment on something the NPCs are talking about. This usually happens during [b]one specific sentence[/b] of the Xeno dialog, so make sure to mention which one it is!

[b]How Dialogs are evaluated[/b]

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/evaluation-1-600x227.jpg[/img]

There are a lot of criteria we will judge dialogs by.
Apart from the more abstract "we just like it", here are a few of them you should definitely consider:

[list]
[*]Does the dialog [b]fit into the setting[/b] of CrossCode?[/*]
[*]Are known character involved in the conversation (e.g. Lea or Emilie) [b]acting in-character[/b]?[/*]
[*]Is it [b]entertaining[/b] or otherwise [b]interesting[/b] to read?[/*]
[*]Is it [b]original[/b] and not redundant with another dialog already in the game?[/*]
[*]Does it have a [b]proper length[/b]? NPCs dialogs should not be too long. About 10 sentences at most. Try to [b]keep it short[/b]![/*]
[*]Does it have [b]proper spelling and grammar[/b]? (Small mistakes are fine, we make them ourselves all the time as well)[/*]
[*]When it includes [b]references[/b] to other games, shows, characters outside of CrossCode, are those references subtle enough so we don't get into trouble?[/*]
[*]Is it safe-for-work? I mean yeah... it's just text. But you never know![/*]
[/list]


[b]Some other rules[/b]

By submitting your dialog, you give us permission to use your dialog, as submitted or in a modified form as well as translated versions of your dialog, in future versions of [b]CrossCode[/b] without further compensation.

...this should all be pretty obvious, but just to be sure!

[h1]CrossCode Christmas Giveaway[/h1]

In addition to the NPC Dialog Contest there is also another "CrossCode Giveaway" raffle, held by our very generous community member [b]streetclaw[/b]!
You can win [b]CrossCode Game + Soundtrack Keys[/b] for Steam and even a complete [b]Foil Cards Set[/b]!

You participate by [url=https://twitter.com/Streetclaw/status/1071434242062774272]retweeting this here tweet[/url]
More Details here: [url=https://streetclaw.de/cccg18/]streetclaw.de/cccg18/[/url]

[h1]We won an award![/h1]

And last but not least, we attended this year's [url=https://deutscherentwicklerpreis.de/gewinner-2018]German Developer Awards[/url] and...

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/award-600x450.jpg[/img]

CrossCode won the [b]Best Indie Game[/b] award! 

We feel very honored especially considering that this year's competition was very strong with games such as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/609320/FAR_Lone_Sails/]Far: Lone Sails[/url] participating.

In addition, we've been nominated in 5 more categories:

[b]Best Game Design[/b]
[b]Best Story[/b]
[b]Best PC/Console Game[/b]
[b]Best German Game[/b]
[b]Best Studio[/b] (for Radical Fish Games)

[h1]Gamedev Stream tonight[/h1]

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/lea-stream-winter-1-600x368.jpg[/img]

This is just a little reminder that we're still holding [b]regular gamedev streams[/b]! In fact, the next one will be [b]today[/b]!

[b]When[/b]: 20:00 CET, 11am PST
[b]What[/b]: We'll work on a new quest for one of our Indiegogo backers! In fact, we'll start working on a new mini boss fight!
[b]Where[/b]: [url=https://twitch.tv/radicalfishgames]twitch.tv/radicalfishgames[/url]

And that's all! There will be another update post still this year (before Christmas) where we talk about ongoing development again.

Until next time!

notes.title: CrossCode 1.0.1 + Future Updates
notes.notes:
[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/highlight-18-10-22-1-600x334.png[/img]

Hello everyball! 

CrossCode reached version 1.0 about one month ago. During the last month we've been mostly busy with the aftermath of the release. That means we fixed bugs. A lot of them. Now, 10 Hotfix releases later, we finally have the time to focus on new content and features again. And today we release the first bunch of them with version 1.0.1!

[h1]Version 1.0.1: New Features[/h1]

CrossCode is a game designed with challenge in mind for both combat and puzzles. However, not all players appreciate this higher difficulty and for some the game becomes downright inaccessible because of it.

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/options-assist-600x338.png[/img]

That's why version 1.0.1 introduces the [b]Assist Mode[/b] that allows you to tweak the difficulty of the game in a detailed manner. If combat is too fast and enemies too hard hitting for you, you can downscale attack frequency and received damage respectively. And if the timed puzzled are too annoying for you to solve, you can downscale the speed / increase the duration of puzzle elements to simplify the execution.

Apart from this, version 1.0.1 also comes with the following features:

[list]
[*]The "Screen shake" option is now properly applied on all screen shake effects of the game[/*]
[*]A new guest role character showed up in Rhombus Square! There might be more in the future[/*]
[*]The new [b]Ninja Skin[/b] has been properly implemented. For now the skin is only available to some of our Indiegogo backers (it was a special Perk), but we plan to also release it as a small DLC for everyone later this year[/*]
[*]And in case you missed it: you can now view your progress for each trophy in the trophy menu[/*]
[/list]

[h1]NW.js and Steam Beta Branch changes[/h1]

We released CrossCode 1.0 using the [b]new NW.js version[/b], but as a lot of players experienced crash issues we quickly downgraded to the old version again, offering the new version through the [b]nwjs_new[/b] beta branch. Through a number of Hotfixes we managed to reduce the amount of crashes, which is why we decided to [b]now use the new NW.js version by default[/b] as it runs better for most players. Instead, we now offer the [b]nwjs_old[/b] BETA branch to switch back to the old version in case the new one still doesn't run well for you.

[h1]Next Steps[/h1]

Next we will finally focus on properly implementing [b]Steam Achievements[/b] which will be directly connected to your [b]Trophies[/b]. That means if you already collected all your Trophies they will be automatically synchronized with Steam Achievements once you start up the game. That's at least the plan.

Another feature we want to look at soon will be [b]Steam Trading Cards[/b]. We're still figuring out how to get the right artworks.

And beyond that, there is still the list of promised [b]End Game[/b] content:

[list]
[*]The final "A Promise is a Promise Quest"[/*]
[*]More Parkour Quests, also featuring new mechanics[/*]
[*]The Arena in Rhombus Square that will come with more combat challenges and a "Boss Rush" mode[/*]
[*]Several new NPCs, Quests and Enemies that we will design together with our Indiegogo backers[/*]
[*]The Last-Minute Hero Guild[/*]
[*]A New Game+ Mode[/*]
[/list]

All of this content will be released with [b]free updates[/b] over the next few months. We will try to get a good part of it done this year, but it's possible that some of these features may have to wait until [b]early 2019[/b].

[h1]The Post Game Episode[/h1]

Those of you that already finished the game might be aware that we hinted to a potential [b]extension of the story[/b]. Originally, we planned to end the game at this point. However, since CrossCode has been pretty successful for quite a while already and there is still an abundance of stupid ideas™, it'd be honestly weird to just end things like this.

That's why we plan to start working on the [b]Post Game Episode[/b] after we have finished all the End Game content. We hope to released it as a [b]DLC sometime in 2019[/b]!

And that's all for now, until next time!

It will come with [i]2 CDs[/i], a [i]high quality clear jewel case[/i], [i]12-page booklet[/i] and it will even include an [i]obi/spine[/i] which is typical for a Japanese soundtrack release. The CD album will ship around [b]November 15th[/b]. You're able to pre-order the album on [url=https://interovgm.bandcamp.com/album/crosscode-original-game-soundtrack]Bandcamp[/url] (US shipping) and directly from [url=https://firstpressgames.com/collections/preorder-releases/products/crosscode-official-soundtrack-cd]First Press Games[/url] (Europe shipping).

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/Frontcover_CD_Mockup_clear_background_1024x10242x-600x412.png[/img]

Deniz is of course also very thrilled about having his debut soundtrack be released on CD! He is always very thankful to anyone who has supported him and bought the soundtrack.

[h1]Hotfix 1.0.0-7[/h1]

Since the initial full release we went through several hotfix updates and the game finally reached a (somewhat) stable state.

[b]Crashes[/b] might still happen though. This is mostly when you use the [b]new NW.js version[/b] for CrossCode (which is default on most platforms and when using the nwjs_new branch on Steam) together with a [b]high sample rate of over 100kHz[/b] in your audio output device settings, since it makes NW.js (the "Web Audio API" in particular) extremely wasteful with memory.

We now did two things to hopefully reduce the amount of crashes.
[list]
[*]Create a [b]64bit application for Windows[/b] that has access to more memory. It should automatically update on Steam accordingly if you have a 64bit OS[/*]
[*][b]Optimize music loading[/b] in general, since the crashes usually happen on maps where a lot of music is loaded at once (this also has the positive side-effect that certain maps will load a lot faster)[/*]
[/list]

Hopefully this will reduce the amount of crashes. If you are a Steam user currently on the default branch, you can try to switch to the nwjs_new beta branch to check if crashes still happen or not. Feedback would be highly appreciated!

And that's all for now.  
Maybe now we can actually afford to take a little break~

[h1]Hotfixes 1.0.0-8 and 1.0.0-9[/h1]

A couple more hotfixes have been added over the last week.

New Features:
[list]
[*]An option to keep the game running when the window is out of focus
[*]Trophy Tracking! You can see status bars for your trophies.
[*]Warnings to notify you about potential performance problems right at the title screen.
[/list]

And of course a lot more smaller fixes, text corrections and other things.

notes.title: Critical Hotfix 1.0.0-1 - How to deal with crash issues
notes.notes:
Game is just out and we already encountered quite a few critical issues.

This is why we now release Hotfix version 1.0.0-1 hoping to fix things.

[h1]What changed[/h1]

[b]We downgraded NW.js (the "engine" of CrossCode) again by default[/b].

We were forced to do this since too many player experienced game-crashing issues with the new NW.js version.

The downside of this is, that the game might run [b]slower[/b] for other players.

For those players we now added the following option:

[h1]Upgrade NW.js by switching to the nwjs_new beta branch[/h1]

There is a new beta branch available called [b]nwjs_new[/b]. By switching to this branch you get CrossCode again with the new [b]NW.js[/b] version.

You switch to the branch like this:

[list]
[*]Rightclick CrossCode in your library
[*]Select [b]Properties[/b]
[*]Select the [b]BETAS[/b] tab
[*]In the top select box, choose [b]nwjs_new[/b]
[*]Verify game files or reinstall
[/list]

[h1]This is confusing what does this mean?![/h1]

Instead of talking about technical stuff lets go through the most common user experiences here:

[b]Case 1: The game was running fine with 1.0.0 but with 1.0.0-1 it's worse[/b]

=> Switch to the [b]nwjs_new[/b] branch

[b]Case 2: The game was crashing with 1.0.0 and you fixed it by downgrading NW.js[/b]

=> Nothing you need to do. The new version has the downgraded NW.js by default.

[b]Case 3: The game was crashing with 1.0.0 and you fixed it without downgrading NW.js[/b]

=> If the new version runs worse for you, you can also switch to [b]nwjs_new[/b]


[h1]More Infos and Troubleshooting[/h1]

For more detailed troubleshooting, please visit this thread:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/368340/discussions/1/1733213724900972605/

Sorry for all the trouble to those player experience the crash issues! We're hard at work to find a good solution that works for as many players as possible!

[h1]More Hotfixes[/h1]

Version 1.0.0-2:
[list]
[*]You can enter the Grabby Cave again
[*]Fixes issue where you could't get credits anymore
[*]Tucos pathfinding issue fixed (hopefully)
[/list]
Version 1.0.0-3:
[list]
[*]Fixing a WORSE Credits bug
[*]You now can't teleport anymore after select to "continue the story"
[/list]
Version 1.0.0-4:
[list]
[*]Fixed crash in last tab of Statistics menu
[*]Fixed crashes for certain boss fights.
[/list]
Version 1.0.0-5:
[list]
[*]Fixed crash issues for the last few boss fights
[/list]
Version 1.0.0-6:
[list]
[*]No crash when using lvl2 cold throw arts at element shield orbs
[*]Lots of smaller fixes
[/list]
Version 1.0.0-7
[list]
[*]Windows now changed to 64bit application for nwjs_new branch
[*]Lot of loading optimizations for certain maps, loading time should be greatly reduced and less likely to crash
[*]Text updates for all localizations, fixing several small issues
[*]You now have 99 stamps per area
[*]Lots of smaller bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: CrossCode 1.0 Out Now!
