https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kkk_omvFSOU

It's here. The day has come. After 7 years of development, half of which were in Early Access, [b]CrossCode 1.0 finally releases[/b]!

Well, what can we say? What a crazy long journey it was. When we started out with CrossCode we've been a small team of inexperienced indie developers. So obviously, we decided to create a fully-featured RPG. Which was stupid ambitious. Yet still... we somehow did it.

And that's because of [b]you[/b]! All you amazing people that backed us on Indiegogo or bought the Early Access version, supported us through the years with feedback, suggestions, tons... TONS of typo fixes or just by cheering us on over all this time. You made it possible for us to not only develop all the content we originally planned, but also to improve the game even further, suggesting features and improvements we never originally thought of.

We want you to know that this means a lot to us. It's really hard to describe how we feel right now. Especially since we had to write this text 3 days in advance. It's probably a mixture of extreme happiness and total exhaustion.

We would also like to thank all of our publishers who greatly helped us getting the word out all across the world.

And now the game is out. So it's up to you to play and hopefully enjoy this game of ours. Let us know what you think!


[h1]Missing Content[/h1]

Just because CrossCode hit [b]full release[/b], doesn't mean it's [b]complete[/b]...!

Well, we already warned you that we might not make it in time and that's pretty much what happened. [b]Steam Achievements[/b] and [b]Trading Cards[/b] are unfortunately not available yet. However, we'll work on this right away and hopefully add those features within the following weeks.

Note that the game [b]already keeps tracks of achievements internally[/b], so there is no need to replay the game after Steam Achievements have been added - you will automatically get all the achievements you already collected once you boot the game.

Other things, that are still missing and will be added in following updates:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/emilieWhy-smol.png[/img]

notes.title: Wot I Think: CrossCode
notes.notes:
Developer: Radical Fish Games
Publisher: Deck13

Release: Out now
On: Windows, Mac
From: Steam, Itch.io, Humble, GOG
Price: 15, $20, 20

Satirical website Hard Drive once ran a story which poked fun at the long, drawn-out nature of most RPGs. In a hard-hitting investigative report, one player was commended for finally getting to the good shit at the 117-hour mark of a fictional title, while his roommate scoffed at him for only making it mid-way through the game. Like most RPGs, CrossCode is an immense and time-intensive experience. Learning all the facets of its world from the combat system to trading with merchants does take a substantial amount of time, but it also makes every minute of this long stretch of time matter. This is done by framing its story as a game-within-a-game , lightly knocking on the fourth wall rather than blustering through it, showing familiarity with the genre, while subverting it at the same time.

notes.title: 2D sci-fi RPG CrossCode gets September 20 release date
notes.notes:
CrossCode, the 2D sci-fi RPG that's proving a big hit in Early Access, will launch in full on September 20, developer Radical Fish Games has announced.

Expect fast combat, physics-based puzzles and old-school, SNES-style graphics, along with a story that will take more than 20 hours to complete. 

I'd never heard of it until last month, but the Steam user reviews suggest it's worth keeping an eye on. 96 per cent of its nearly 2,500 user reviews during Early Access have been positive, and it was chosen as one of Steam’s top-rated, least-played games last year.

In a blog post announcing the release date, Radical Fish detailed exactly what will be added in update 1.0. Several existing areas of the game are expanded, and a new area called Rhombus City—the largest city in the game—has been added. There will also be more party members, quests, boss fights and enemy types.

Several extras that the developer promised during Early Access will arrive after full release, including a New Game+ mode, a boss rush mode and several NPCs. The game will likely get extra DLC in the future, depending on how the release goes, Radical Fish said.

Read the blog post for more details, and grab a free demo on the Steam page.

notes.title: Action RPG CrossCode levels up out of early access September 20th
notes.notes:
I reckon that CrossCode is quietly one of the more exciting things lurking around in Steam’s early access section right now. It’s a fast-paced action RPG in the vein of Terranigma or Secret Of Mana, set in a pseudo-virtual world that reminds me of Phantasy Star Online. Initially demoed and crowdfunded back in February 2015, with plans to launch at the start of 2016. Obviously that didn’t work out, but judging by CrossCode’s massive strides made during its time in early access, it was worth the wait. The developers have announced It’s releasing on September 20th.

notes.title: 2D RPG CrossCode will leave Early Access in September
notes.notes:
Highly rated 2D action RPG CrossCode will leave Early Access in September, Radical Fish Games has announced. 

If you haven’t heard of it before then—judging by its user ratings on Steam—you should probably get to know it. It was also picked out as one of Steam’s top-rated, least-played games last year, so it probably deserves a little more love.

It combines 16-bit SNES-style visuals with a more modern physics system, fast combat and puzzle solving. There's plenty of loot to find and sci-fi dungeons to explore, and it'll take between 20 and 25 hours to blast through the full story when it comes out.

The developer's YouTube channel essentially chronicles CrossCode's development in real time: each video, a couple of which are released every month, is around five hours long and shows the development team at work on various aspects of the game, whether that's adding new facial expressions or tweaking enemies.

It has a free demo on Steam so you can try it out before the full release in September. A more precise date will arrive in early August, the developers said in a blog post. You can watch it in action below, but just bear in mind this trailer is a year old.

June has been one month of 100% CrossCode gamedev. And as a result, we made a lot of progress! Getting really close!

[h1]Final To Do List Update[/h1]

[url=https://www.radicalfishgames.com/?page_id=5985]
[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/release-schedule-intense-cropped-1-300x146.jpg[/img]
Click here to see the updated To Do List.
[/url]

In June we finally managed to decently chip down on those numbers! We made a lot of progress with story and cut scenes, finished another major battle sequence and completed a whole bunch of quests!

That's why we are still optimistic for a 1.0 release around [b]end of summer[/b] (late August-September)! 
We still didn't decide on precise release date yet, but that might happen soonish as well.

And of course, here a few more spoiler-free screenshot of recent progress:

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/story-cave-600x338.png[/img]
Here a very ambigious screenshot of a recently finished story event that hopefully doesn't spoil anything... Look! It's a shiny cave!

[url=https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/residential-overview.png][img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/residential-overview-600x448.png[/img][/url]
We further worked on Rhombus Square, roughly completing another part of the city... except for that one large house in the lower left. That still needs some work.

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/botanics-quest-600x338.png[/img]
The Botanics Quest has been completed so you now get a lot of fancy rewards for your progress!

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/henry-quest-600x338.png[/img]
Henry's quest chain has been roughly completed as well! More searching of those devices!

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/old-man-quest-600x338.png[/img]
Strange new Plants have appeared in CrossWorlds and might hold the key to the Old Man's Secret!

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/items-add-ons-600x338.png[/img]
Another small feature: The game will now include "Add-Ons" that allow you to enable/disable things independent of equipment! Equipment like "Holiday Hat" and "Sparkling Boots" that change your appearance/add visual effects have been converted to "Add-Ons" so you can "wear" them at any time, without having to use outdated equipment!

And that's pretty much it. Until next time! Hopefully with some great news regarding a 1.0 release.

notes.title: Hi-Lights + May To Do List Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/highlight-18-06-01-600x334.png[/img]

Hello everyball!

May is already over so it's time to update that To Do list and talk about recent progress! Also a short recap of last month's events and more!

[h1]Final To Do List Update[/h1]

[url=https://www.radicalfishgames.com/?page_id=5985]
[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/release-schedule-intense-cropped-1-300x146.jpg[/img]
Click here to see the updated To Do List.
[/url]

May was the month we attended both BitSummit and Dokomi - which included a fair bit of preparation and traveling. That is why we expected (and calculated) that less work would get done this month. However, despite all this we actually made some pretty good progress, especially towards the end of the month.

With the way things are going, we still hope for a release of version 1.0 around [b]end of Summer[/b].

Now as for what exactly happened this month... there are at least a few things we can show without spoiling too much:

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/patience-small.gif[/img]
Things are happening in [b]Sapphire Ridge[/b] and it somehow involves this [b]bamboo fountain[/b].

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/quest-temple-600x338.png[/img]
Additionally, new [b]optional temples[/b] are emerging in [b]Gaia's Garden[/b]!

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/items-availability-600x338.png[/img]
Finally, we even managed to squeeze in a little quality of life improvement: [b]availability information in the inventory[/b]. Note: the information shown in this screen is just an example and not accurate! No, Hedgehags will not start dropping bare Junk Metal!

[h1]Events and Awards in May[/h1]
As announced in last post, we attended both [b]BitSummit[/b] and [b]Dokomi[/b] presenting CrossCode!

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/bitsummit-2018-600x450.jpg[/img]
CrossCode at BitSummit next to all those other great games published by Dangen like [url=https://dangenentertainment.com/games/fight-knight]Fight Knight[/url] and [url=https://dangenentertainment.com/games/super-sportmatchen]Super Sportmatchen[/url]... check them out!

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/dokomi-600x450.jpg[/img]
Our large CrossCode booth at Dokomi, this time organized by [url=https://indiearenabooth.de/]Indie Arena Booth[/url] right next to [url=https://twitter.com/IndieArenaBooth/status/998831960305913856]lots of other indie developers[/url]!

We had plenty of visitors on both events and some even bringing us [url=https://twitter.com/RadicalFishGame/status/997832918079651841]fanart[/url] and... [url=https://twitter.com/lachsen/status/997520305215168519]other fanart[/url]...

Anyway, that's all for events! From now on we're 100% focused on finishing this game!

And what else? Oh yeah! To everyone's surprise, we actually won our [b]very first award[/b]!

[img]https://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/rpc-award-225x300.jpg[/img]
CrossCode got the [url=https://www.rpc-germany.org/award-2018/]RPC Fantasy Award for Most Promising Product[/url] at the [url=https://www.rpc-germany.org/]Role-Play-Convention[/url] in Cologne, Germany! Yay!

And that's all! Until the next update!

notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8768797/7f2ade370a7c5ef4b0428c73f3334dd3d9639ffa.png[/img]

Hello everyball!

Here we are again, back with fully written text!

Since April is now pretty much over, it's time for another update of our Final To Do list. We also have a few new things to show + a couple events in May we will attend!

[h1]Final To Do List Update[/h1]

[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/?page_id=5985]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8768797/f10026e9770761f5983010c8efd17b0dbc71cf88.jpg[/img]
Click here to see the updated To Do List.
[/url]

It may not look like it, but overall April was fairly productive. That's because we completed several tasks that are not directly shown by the numbers including:

[list]
[*]Implementing the last puzzle mechanics of version 1.0[/*]
[*]Completing tileset graphics for Rhombus Square[/*]
[*]Planning the layout of remaining content in more detail[/*]
[*]Writing dialogues of remaining scenes[/*]
[/list]

Anyway here's hope that content production will accelerate in the next few month, since most of these "preparation tasks" have been completed now.

Here are a few impressions of recently developed content:

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1Xg6oxvQCcWNflQ6k1/giphy.gif[/img]
Finally you can enter the city of Rhombus Square!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3XviBuYyLdADsrwLMS/giphy.gif[/img]
A few impressions of the still empty shopping district.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/KYGfnQWjuamBrny4aC/giphy.gif[/img]
There will actually be traffic on those streets! And yes there will be more car variations.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8768797/62438aed645d647b93f411bff1961afd07dc67a6.png[/img]
Meanwhile in Sapphire Ridge: New combat challenges emerge!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8768797/72965d4c9742678728b08e48598ce0dfae1a9f06.png[/img]
And even though we didn't manage to finish any quest this month, we're still working on it and more quests for Gaia's Garden will follow soon!

As for a [b]release date[/b]: Sorry, but we're still not ready. Our goal is to first roughly finish all major gameplay and story content before we fix a release date, so we can be certain that we don't have to delay again and can focus on testing and polishing the content.  However, we're getting very close to that point and still aim for a release in Summer 2018!

[h1]Upcoming events[/h1]

Since the release of CrossCode 1.0 is drawing near, we decided it would be worthwhile to present the game once again on certain events. And we ended up deciding to visit the same two events in May that we already visited last year:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8768797/cbbf6ab999c7eda031a0bd3c2c0d823c6c58cbfd.png[/img]
We’ll be attending [url=https://bitsummit.jp/]BitSummit[/url] in May 12-13 in Kyoto, Japan!

And just on the next weekend...

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8768797/e8ce242451f54d4b938e26922cebd03653434ac5.png[/img]
We’ll also attend [url=https://www.dokomi.de/]Dokomi[/url] in May 19-20 in Düsseldorf, Germany!

If you happen to be around, feel free to drop by and say hello! We may have a bit of CrossCode merch with us in fact!

[h1]A little hotfix[/h1]

And just as a side note: With this update we also release another small Hotfix (Version [b]0.9.8-7[/b]), which doesn't add any new content, but actually just fixes one issue that we didn't want to keep in the game until 1.0 which is that the Goat Father has been kicking instakill nukes.

And that's all! Until the next update!

[b]Note: Translations of this post to Japanese/Chinese/Korean will follow soon[/b]

notes.title: CrossCode: Getting closer to 1.0
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/release-schedule-header-2-600x300.png[/img]

Hello everyball!

Now that we safely entered the year 2018, a lot of you will probably ask the same question: [b]1.0 Release when[/b]? Today we want to talk about recent development and how close we really are to finally leaving Early Access.

[h1]Recent development and 1.0 Release Date[/h1]

After the (sort of expected) drought over the holidays, things have been kicking up again in January and we made a lot of progress, especially with [b]story development[/b]!

We still don't want to show anything of that because... well... spoilers.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/no-spoilers-1.jpg[/img]

Instead, here is a more abstract list of things we did over the last few month (also in parallel to the recent releases):

[list]
 	[*]Finished the probably most story-intense part of the game (almost fully playable)[/*]
 	[*]Fully planned out most remaining story-details[/*]
 	[*]Created written drafts for almost all major dialogues of the main story[/*]
 	[*]Mostly finished the Main Story Quests for Gaia's Garden[/*]
 	[*]Started development of quests for Basin Keep[/*]
[/list]

We're getting close...  but we're not quite there yet. Things again took longer than expected (yes, we know, it's getting old). It's now early 2018 but we still can't properly fix a release date. 

With the way things are going right now, we hope to finish CrossCode sometime around [b]mid 2018[/b].

Still, we ARE really close! So close in fact that we can exactly count the amount of content that is still missing. And since we can't show a lot of screenshots and gifs of recent development due to spoilers we had a little idea:

We'll share with you our [b]Final To-Do List[/b]!

This to-do list is made in way to keep things very abstract so it shouldn't spoil a lot of content. Still, it will give you a rough impression of how much content is left and if you want to have the full surprise, you may want to avoid looking at it. So tl;dr: [b]Minor Spoiler Warning[/b]!

We plan to update this to-do list over the next few month. That way, you get an impression of how much progress we make over time and how close we really are to a 1.0 release!

[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/?page_id=5985]
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/release-schedule-intense-cropped-1-300x146.jpg[/img]
Click here for the Final To-Do List!
[/url]

With this list we can hopefully show you that things are moving forward and towards a conclusion. We are, once again, very sorry that things are taking longer than expected. 

[h1]About releasing version 0.9.9[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/rhombus-square-when-1-600x163.png[/img]

In our previous schedule we planned to release version 0.9.9 before end of 2017, which would include [b]All level 3 combat arts[/b] and [b]Rhombus Square[/b]. We managed to release all level 3 combat arts with version [b]0.9.8[/b] still in time, but Rhombus Square isn't quite ready yet. That's why we planned to release version [b]0.9.9[/b] sometime soon, featuring [b]Rhombus Square[/b] and [b]additional Quests[/b], but still no more story.

However, now that we focus on developing the remaining story content there is one thing we realize: [b]releasing another version before 1.0 will be difficult[/b].  	[*]Created written drafts for almost all major dialogues of the main story[/*]

notes.title: CrossCode 0.9.8 - More languages and all the Arts!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/version-up-0.9.8-600x349.jpg[/img]

On our long journey towards version 1.0 we've now reached another small milestone: Today we release [b]version 0.9.8[/b]! This update will add [b]all level 3 combat arts[/b], a [b]Japanese[/b] and [b]Korean[/b] translation, a couple of [b]quests[/b] and several small [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b]! Let's go!

[h1]New Localizations[/h1]

After several month of collaboration with our new partners we're happy to announce that CrossCode now supports two more languages!

First: a [b]Japanese localization[/b] by [url=http://dangenentertainment.com/]Dangen Entertainment[/url]!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/japanese-1-600x338.png[/img]
It's like one of your Japanese JRPGs!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/japanese-2-600x338.png[/img]
Which means we can't read it! Gotta wait for those fansubs. :/

Second: a [b]Korean localization[/b] by [url=http://www.mayflowerent.com/]Mayflower Entertainment[/url]!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/korean-1-600x338.png[/img]
Still can't read this!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/korean-2-600x338.png[/img]
We really hope the translations are good!

Anyway...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/options-lang-more-600x338.png[/img]
You can select the new languages within the options. [b]Remember to restart the game![/b]

[h1]All the Combat Arts[/h1]
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/lvl3-mix.gif[/img]
It's finally done! This version comes with [b]all level 3 combat arts fully implemented[/b]!

In order to learn those arts you'll have to collect the [b]Star Shade[/b] at the end of the [b]Jungle dungeon[/b]. Once learned you'll need to spend [b]6 SP[/b] in order to use them. 

The good news is: We'll [b]upgrade your MAX SP to 12[/b] (which means 3 SP on battle start) once you collect the Star Shade! So gathering the necessary SP should be somewhat quicker.

[h1]Small Usability Improvements[/h1]

We made several small improvements for menus and interface.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/questFavNew-600x338.png[/img]
Quest marking has changed. You can now mark [b]multiple quests[/b] inside the menu and you can only switch between marked quest on the field.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/circuit-reset-600x338.png[/img]
We properly integrated a [b]Circuit Reset[/b] option! You can visit a terminal in [b]Rookie Harbor[/b] that allows you to reset [b]individual Circuit trees[/b]. However, resetting isn't as cheap anymore: you'll need to use a [b]Circuit Override[/b] item that you will get on several occasions during the plot. We might also add a trading option later on.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/activatedAll-600x338.png[/img]
To reskill yourself even faster you also now have the option to learn several skills in one go!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/tradeHide-600x338.png[/img]
There are also several small QoL improvements like grayed trading items in the preview if you can't trade them yet, and number of collected chests visible on the world map.

[h1]A few more quests[/h1]

This version comes with a few more quests as well! Two of them are found in [b]Rookie Harbor[/b] and another one in [b]Gaia's Garden[/b]!

There's even a little boss fight included!

[h1]More Stuff in the Background[/h1]

Just like the last release, this one is again rather small. We're still working on more content in the background that will be released with version 1.0!
So once again... Sorry for the small update but we hope that the wait will be worth it once version 1.0 will be out!

Anyway that's all! 

We hope you have fun with version 0.9.8 and let's hope there's a limit to the amount of bugs!

[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/ja-ko-release-combo-1.png][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/ja-ko-release-combo-1-600x848.png[/img][/url]

Hello everyball! Suddenly it's December so some of you might wonder: what about that [b]Version 0.9.9 Release?[/b] Well we got some news for you and also some GIFs and Images of Recent Progress!

[h1]Release of the next version[/h1]

In the original schedule we planned for a release of [b]Version 0.9.9[/b] in December including all [b]Level 3 combat arts[/b] as well as [b]Rhombus Square[/b]. While we already made some progress with Rhombus Square, it's likely not going to be ready before Christmas. However, we did manage to [b]complete all the combat arts[/b]! That's why we decided to split the release in two versions: [b]0.9.8[/b] and [b]0.9.9[/b]. Rhombus Square will be release with version 0.9.9 in the Beginning of next year (January - February). 

Version [b]0.9.8[/b] will be released on [b]December 14[/b] and will include:

[list]
[*]All level 3 combat arts - that means the circuit is 100% completed[/*]
[*]A couple new quests[/*]
[*]Several small quality-of-life improvements[/*]
[/list]

Oh... and also: [b]A complete Japanese and Korean localization[/b]!

As with the last release, note that this release is smaller since we're still working on more stuff in the background for version [b]1.0[/b].

[h1]Recent Progress[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/activatedAll-600x338.png[/img]You can now chain activate multiple nodes in the circuit tree! Simply activate the option in the options menu, select a node and watch as all the skills get activated.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/questFavNew-600x338.png[/img]We reworked the quest-favorite system. Instead of marking just one quest as favorite, you can now set as many as you want and only toggle through them on the field! No more lingering unfinished quests you need to go through!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/tradeHide-600x338.png[/img]Trades you can't make because you lack the resource or money are now grayed out.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/statusModsNew-600x338.png[/img]We changed the order of modifiers. From now on they will be grouped more logically so you don't find a damage modifier next to a status condition one and so on.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/chestCount-600x338.png[/img]A small change but probably a welcome one too: When hovering above and area on the world map, it will now show how many chests you can still find in that area.

And now, as for level 3 combat arts, there're a lot of them sO GET READY FOR GIFS!

MOBILE USERS, YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED.

Sky-high streams of fire!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/cold-lvl3-melee.gif[/img]
Massive spin attacks!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/cold-lvl3-throw.gif[/img]
TANKS!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/cold-lvl3-melee2.gif[/img]
Gigantic Icicles!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/shock-lvl3-throw1.gif[/img]
Enormous Lightning Strikes!

Time halting combos!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/shock-lvl3-dash2.gif[/img]
Lighting-fast tackles!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/shock-lvl3-melee.gif[/img]
Even faster melee combos!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/wave-lvl3-throw.gif[/img]
Highly-explosive projectiles!

Duplicating dash combos!

And that's all! See you again in December 14 for the next release!

notes.title: CrossCode now with Steam Cloud Support!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/steam-cloud-600x368.jpg[/img]

Good news everyone: [b]We finally implemented support for Steam Cloud![/b]

That means that your CrossCode saves can now be backed up in the Cloud and shared for all CrossCode installations. It even should work cross platform. Hopefully.

If you don't want your saves to be synchronized, you can disable Steam Cloud for CrossCode. (Right click the game, select "Properties", then the "UPDATES" tab and uncheck "Enable Steam Cloud synchronization for CrossCode").

[b]Important[/b]: Note that we don't support a proper [b]merging[/b] of save states. That means if you have two different sets of saves on two machines and want to use Steam Cloud, you will have to replace one set of saves with the others. Steam should give you a warning in that case and an option to select which saves you want to keep.

If there are any issues with save synchronization, please let us now!

And that's all!

[h1]New Area: Sapphire Ridge[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/sapphire-ridge3-1-600x338.png[/img]
With [b]Sapphire Ridge[/b] we now added the [b]final outdoor area[/b] of CrossCode! 

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/sapphire-ridge-cave3-600x338.png[/img]
It's a medium sized area, comparable to Autumn's Fall, but stuffed with lots of caves and crazy environment puzzles!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/new-bugs-2-3.gif[/img]
You will also find a total of [b]4 new enemies[/b], ready to be fought! Including new [b]bugs[/b]. Be warned, Emilie.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/sapphire-ridge4-2-600x338.png[/img]
Sapphire Ridge also includes the [b]Cave Inn[/b] - it's not a full fledged town or village, but still a fairly large building.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/sapphire-ridge-shop-600x338.png[/img]
Inside you'll find a lot of new offers for equipment and more!

Of course, Sapphire Ridge still isn't entirely finished. We still plan to tweak things and add more quests and NPCs to the area in future versions. But otherwise it's ready for exploration!

[h1]Trophies[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/trophies-600x338.png[/img]

With this version we finally release [b]Trophies[/b], which are essentially achievements! You find a list of all the trophies within the [b]Synopsis[/b] menu. 

You get Trophies for reaching certain points in the game, defeating certain enemies, mastering certain feats and more! Currently there are a total of [b]171 trophies[/b] that can be collected... at least partly!

[b]Note[/b]: Trophies are currently [b]not[/b] connected to Steam Achievements, but we plan to do so in the future (at least for some trophies). Once it's done, your trophies will automatically synchronize with Steam achievements. So getting the Trophies now means you'll get the Steam Achievement in the future!

[b]Second Note[/b]: Some of the Trophies might still be buggy and might not correctly synchronize with old saves. Sometimes, doing certain things in the game might trigger an evaluation so you'll get the trophies at that point. Otherwise, you can report those issues and we'll see how we can fix it.

[h1]More Quests[/h1]
As always, there are [b]more quests[/b]! This time we have 3 new quests for you that you can find in [b]Rookie Harbor[/b] and [b]Ba'kii Kum[/b]. Each of them features unique gameplay mechanics or even boss fights! So make sure to check them out! 

Here some impressions:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/ball-quest-600x338.png[/img]
A very unique quest featuring a floating "ball" in Autumn's Fall!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/ocean-quest-2-600x338.png[/img]
Fighting Turrets. Again. This time on the ocean.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/quest-boss-1-600x338.png[/img]
A boss fight featuring the most popular type of enemies: Sharksters.

[h1]Upgraded Portraits[/h1]

With this version we finally got around upgrading a lot of the portraits from older versions, including [b]Captain Jet[/b], that [b]Blue Avatar[/b], and [b]Satoshi[/b]:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/new-portraits-5-600x338.png[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/new-portraits-6-600x338.png[/img]

Additionally, we improved all the dark shaded portraits of generic NPCs, adding more details and variations to more closely match the NPC:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/new-portraits-2-2-600x338.png[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/new-portraits-1-2-600x338.png[/img]

We still plan to add more variations in the future.

[h1]More Stuff[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/quest-hub-600x338.png[/img]

This update features a couple more smaller changes:

[list]
[*]The [b]info/nerd hub[/b] in Rookie Harbor has been overhauled and features new NPCs to explain all the things to you![/*]
[*]Lots of [b]sound improvements[/b] especially for enemies. Try fighting the Faj'ro Temple boss again![/*]
[*][b]Improved German Translation[/b] extended - all main story dialogues until Temple Mine have been overhauled![/*]
[*]You can finally enter the [b]Pub in Rookie Harbor[/b] right next to the teleporter at the sea.[/*]
[*]You can now adjust some new [b]graphic settings[/b] in the video options section. Those include toggling particle effects, weather and lighting.[/*]
[*][b]More map pins variants[/b] have been added for [b]arrows[/b]. Also the padding between pins has been decreased.[/*]
[*]Various map adjustments to [b]Autumn's Rise[/b].[/*]
[/list]

[h1]More Stuff... but HIDDEN![/h1]
Just in case you wonder why this update is relatively small: we've been working on a lot more content in the background. Content that's relevant to the final plot. Since we don't want to release any more story until version 1.0, the current update turned out rather small. The same will be true for the next update to version 0.9.9. However, in turn you can expect a [b]huge update[/b] once we release the complete story. That way, you can enjoy the rest of the story in one go!

In other words: Sorry for the small update, but hopefully it will all pay off once we release version 1.0!

And that's all for this update! We hope you have fun with CrossCode version 0.9.7!

And now let the bug hunt commence!
You know... the one in Sapphire Ridge... and the one in the code. x_x

notes.title: Hi-Lights + Version 0.9.7 release date
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/highlight-17-10-05-600x334.png[/img]

Hello everyball! It's October and that means we're now safely within Autumn. So what about that [b]0.9.7 release[/b]? It's almost ready! Today we announce the release date for the next update and also show recent progress including the output of our recent [b]CrossWeek[/b]!

[h1]Release Date for version 0.9.7[/h1]

Let's get right to the point: we plan to release the update next week on [b]October 13, 2017[/b].
On a [b]Friday[/b]. Such a nice date, right?

Anyway, here is what you can expect from [b]CrossCode 0.9.7[/b].

[list]
[*] [b]New Area: Sapphire Ridge[/b] with new enemies and lots of crazy jumping puzzles.[/*]
[*]Several new [b]Quests[/b] in Ba'kii Kum and Rookie Harbor.[/*]
[*]Updated [b]Portrait Graphics[/b] for Captain Jet, Satoshi and lots of other NPCs[/*]
[/list]

As you can probably see, version [b]0.9.7[/b] doesn't include a lot of new content. That's not because we've been lazy (mostly) but because we've been working on a lot of [b]story content[/b] that we still want to keep secret until the [b]1.0 release[/b]. Essentially we're going for a [b]very big 1.0 release[/b] that will come with a ton of new content at once so that you play the rest of the story up to its conclusion in one go.

[h1]CrossWeek + Recent Progress[/h1]

Since the last post we made a lot of progress with Sapphire Ridge, which is why we can now share a lot of new screenshots:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/sapphire-ridge1-600x338.png[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/sapphire-ridge3-600x338.png[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/sapphire-ridge4-600x338.png[/img]

Sapphire Ridge also comes with several new caves:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/sapphire-ridge-cave1-600x338.png[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/sapphire-ridge-cave2-600x338.png[/img]

And also plenty new enemies such as...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/new-bugs-2-2.gif[/img]
...new mysterious bugs...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/pandza.gif[/img]
...mechanical pandas....

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/spiders.gif[/img]
...and too many spiders.

In addition we've been working on [b]new quests[/b] such as:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/quest-boss-600x338.png[/img]
...fighting strange sharkster boss enemies and...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/ocean-quest-wip-600x338.png[/img]
...fighting floating turrets in the middle of the ocean (this one is still very much WIP).

And finally, as mentioned before, we found the time to polish a lot of old portraits including all those overly simplified NPC portrait

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/new-portraits-1-1-600x338.png[/img]
Guards now wear proper helmets!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/new-portraits-2-1-600x338.png[/img]
Random NPCs have... EYES!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/new-portraits-3-600x338.png[/img]
Shads are more shiny than ever!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/new-portraits-4-600x338.png[/img]
Captain Jet is more fancy looking as well!

Also, a lot of the new stuff you see here has been created during our most recent [b]CrossWeek[/b]!
CrossWeek is where part of the team meets up in Hannover, Germany to work on CrossCode full-time for a whole week. That usually means we get a lot of stuff done and that was definitely the case this time!

And if you're curious how CrossWeek looks like here a few photos:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/gamedev-cooking-at-the-same-time-600x450.jpg[/img]
Doing gamedev and cooking at the same time!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/breaking-ovens-600x450.jpg[/img]
Breaking ovens! At least we didn't burn anything this time.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/team-board-end-600x450.jpg[/img]
Finishing most of the tasks!

That's all for today! We hope you look forward to the next 0.9.7 update. Until then!

notes.title: Hotfix Release 0.9.5-5 + Contest Winners!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/bulletin-board.gif[/img]


We spent the last week fixing smaller and more nuanced bugs, but also managed to squeeze in a few new features and additions! All of this is now released with [b]Hotfix Version 0.9.5-5[/b]! Also the [b]boss contest[/b] just ended and we've already chosen the [b]winner[/b]!

[h1]Hotfix Release 0.9.5-5[/h1]
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/new-item-consum.gif[/img]

The newest version should fix another batch of smaller issues, including:
[list]

[b][u]稍等等[/u][/b]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/apollo-top-line.png[/img]
[i]Of course, one of the cheaters. There is no justice. I'm outta here.[/i]
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/apollo-disappoint.png[/img]


And that's all for today's post! This was likely the last CrossCode hotfix for 0.9.5... unless even more unexpected issues come up.
That means we'll now focus on content for version 0.9.7 and beyond!

Until next time!

[*][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Jw7zD6u0bOY]影子[/url] was [b]level 18[/b] and was just wearing [b]rookie equipment[/b] resulting in the lowest stats of all participants! The video showcases another long and painful battle with lots of interesting techniques, like switching elements during combat arts to optimize damage as far as possible. In the end 影子 was victorious. Absolutely incredible![/*]
[/list]

We're quite blown away to see that level of skill from our players!


[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/apollo-top-line.png[/img]
[i]... Alright. I admit it. Very impressive.[/i]
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/apollo-lecturing.png[/img]


Now, the winner is randomly drawn from all of these submissions! We did so live during yesterday's [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uTieXsexyoY&t=1466]gamedev stream[/url] (just ignore the mistake where we've chosen the wrong person at first...)!

And the winner is...

[b][u]稍等等[/u][/b]

Congratulations, you won a [b]guest NPC somewhere in CrossCode[/b]! We'll make sure to contact you once we start implementing those NPCs.


[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/apollo-top-line.png[/img]
[i]Of course, one of the cheaters. There is no justice. I'm outta here.[/i]
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/apollo-disappoint.png[/img]


And that's all for today's post! This was likely the last CrossCode hotfix for 0.9.5... unless even more unexpected issues come up.
That means we'll now focus on content for version 0.9.7 and beyond!

Until next time!

notes.title: CrossCode 0.9.5 Story Time!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/version-up-0.9.5-600x349.jpg[/img]

Yes, yes... It's finally time to continue the story of CrossCode! And boy, did we take our sweet time with it. Though we did also release some [url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/?p=5608]cool new stuff in between[/url], so it's all good, right? 

Anyway, this update doesn't just continue the story but also adds in new features, balancing and so on. We also got another [b]Contest[/b] for you! Let's get right to it!

[h1]Finally More Story[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/fajro-end-600x338.png[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/dream-600x338.png[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/team-event-600x338.png[/img]

This is the big one. The story continues in Ba'kii Kum. C'tron will be properly introduced and you get to spend more time with the First Scholar guild. In case you already continued playing you have the [b]option to get set back to the previous end of the story[/b]. We strongly encourage you to do so since the game will [b]most definitely break otherwise[/b]! But don't worry you can keep all the loot you obtained.

This story will also take you into an area some of you might already know...

[h1]Extending Autumn's Fall[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/autumns-fall-extended-2-600x338.png[/img]

Autumn's Fall got a bit bigger! The area felt a bit small at times and since we wanted story to happen in the area we decided to add a few maps all neatly tight together with a quest that is required in order to progress. 

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/daft-frobbit.gif[/img]

Prepare for a real mischief maker!

Also for the first time ever, Rookie Harbor North opens up! The map is still Work-in-Progress but we already have a lot of happy people strolling about. 

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/rookie-harbor-north-600x338.png[/img]

[h1]Equipment Level[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/equip_levels-600x338.png[/img]

We often had the feedback that players felt under-powered, even when the enemy level matched the player level. Usually the reason for this was that players used equipment that was outdated relative to the foes they were facing. [b]Equipment plays a huge role in your stats.[/b] Much more than skills or level-ups. It was our mistake to not properly communicate the importance of equipment enough. Now with [b]showing a level for each equipment piece[/b] we feel it's much easier to notice when it's time to upgrade!

So as you can see, each piece of [b]equipment now shows you which level[/b] it is best used at. No worries: the level is [b]only a recommendation, not a requirement[/b] you can still wear whatever gear you can get your hands on! Additionally we added a small UI in the equipment menu that shows both the player- and average equipment level. Your equipment level should always be above or equal to the player level. [b]Colors indicate how well the levels are aligned[/b]. Here's a small clip showing how it looks in action:

https://gfycat.com/FinishedFreeAntarcticgiantpetrel

And lastly we made small change to how the [b]colors are displayed when checking out an enemy via your Seeker Senses[/b]. Instead of just comparing your level against the enemy level it now also includes the average equipment level. This means that when fighting an enemy at the same level you might still get a red color indicating that his enemy is stronger than you are. 

We hope that these changes will help players in the future. It could be said that this feature was implemented thanks to the community, so thanks everyone for the feedback!

[h1]MORE QUESTS[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/quest_boxes-600x338.png[/img]
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/quest_drink-600x338.png[/img]
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/quest_train-600x338.png[/img]
What? You thought we would release a major update without new quests? As always we tried to come up with interesting ideas as well as stories. New Quests can be found in Ba'kii Kum, Basin Keep (Remember the Galaxy Spiral Drill Trader? Visit him again. However his quest is not finished right now.), Bergen and Rookie Harbor. 

But this time we also [b]removed quests[/b]! Namely those tedious and [b]boring fetch-quests you could get at the Rookie Harbor Questhub[/b]. Instead the Faction-Indroduction-NPC and a new quest NPC will be in front of the desk. Hopefully this gives a better first impression of quests!

Finally, you might notice that we added new UIs for quests too. Like a nice countdown or a dedicated score UI for quests including mini games.

[h1]Controls[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/options_melee_guard-600x338.png[/img]

A common request we had ever since we released the game was the people would like to have [b]a dedicated Melee- and Guard-Button[/b]. Well, guess what? We finally implemented it! Mouse & Keyboard users can setup the button inside the bindings section of the options menu. Gamepad users can use X/Square for a melee attack and B/Circle for guarding. 
We added some additional options to disable the melee/guard actions for the previous input methods in case you want to go all out on the new setting.


[h1]New Music[/h1]

Of course this update also includes a few new themes composed by Intero himself. You listen to them on his Twitter account through these links:

[b]Lea's Theme[/b]

https://twitter.com/interovgm/status/874568358032809984

[b]Battle Theme[/b]

https://twitter.com/interovgm/status/844540035106050048

[b]Casual Theme[/b]

https://twitter.com/interovgm/status/836333376693026816

[b]Sorrow Theme[/b]

https://twitter.com/interovgm/status/880903410853269504

[h1]Other Stuff[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/buff_desc-600x338.png[/img]
You can now finally see what each buff item does! Just hover over an item, press H/Start to open the help screen and select the icon in the bottom left corner. As you can see, you will get a nice overview over what each icon means. Plus, the buff icons now look much better. Thanks T-Free!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/stamps-600x338.png[/img]
Also you can now place [b]Pins[/b] on your map, choosing from a number of symbols! That should help to keep track on things you find around the area.

We also spend a lot of time [b]balancing equipment and enemies again[/b]. Spoilers: HP Regen got a nerf! It was just way too powerful! But on the plus side, enemies now have new damage ceilings preventing them from doing too much damage to the player at once! (Looking at you Mr. Snowman.) Overall equipment has also been buffed. Especially the trader gear which sometimes felt weaker compared to the base equipment you could buy.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/lang-600x338.png[/img]
This new language selection UI has also been added to make it easier to add more languages later on. As you can see you get a nice flag icon now! Doesn't it look slick? 

More changes can be found in the changelog inside the game as usual.

[h1]Contest: Win the PvP Fight![/h1]

Another Boss contest? Sure why not! In fact, version 0.9.5 comes with [b]several new boss fights[/b]!
What we want you to record is the [b]PvP Battle[/b] that you will have [b]in front of Faj'ro Temple[/b]!

[b]Show us how you win the PvP battle in front of Faj'ro Temple[/b]!

Just create a [b]public video[/b] (Youtube, Twitch, doesn’t matter) and send us a link to [b]contest@radicalfishgames.com[/b].
You can add your live reaction or leave it out, whatever you prefer!

Among all people who send us a video, we’ll draw the following prize:
[b]You get your personal NPC guest role somewhere in CrossWorlds - you decide the location[/b]! You can be an Avatar, a regular citizen or maybe something else? We’ll work together to figure out the details!
[b]Deadline: Saturday, July 8, 23:59 PST[/b]



Alright, that's it. Quite a lot, we know. It's time for you to play now! And once you're done, tell us what you think about the new stuff.

Until next time!

... [b]Let the bug reports commence[/b]!

notes.title: 2 Years Early Access + Release Schedule Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/crosscode-schedule-2017-1-600x455.jpg[/img]
Woah, has it really been 2 years already? Indeed: CrossCode started Early Access back in May 2015. To celebrate the occasion we have a [b]Daily Deal[/b] today on Steam!

Now before some of you might be tempted to take the offer we thought it would be fair to talk about the ever-so-important question: 
[b]When is CrossCode finally finished?[/b]

Back in 2016 we posted our [url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/?p=5274]release schedule[/url] and at that time, we estimated the final release for [b]June-September 2017[/b]. We're now very close at this date and unfortunately see that there is still [b]too much left to do[/b]. Yes, most major locations and dungeons have been finished and you can already gather all 4 elements. The only major thing that is now missing is the [b]story[/b]. And story is difficult. It's important to us that the plot will leave enough space for character development, will be able to surprise you and most important of all: will have a satisfying conclusion. All of this unfortunately takes time, more than we estimated.

[b]The only way we could release on time would be by cutting content[/b], making the game shorter than intended. This will of course leave the final product lacking and we really want to avoid this.

The good news is: [b]financially we can afford to develop the game until it reaches the intended conclusion[/b]. That of course means we have to postpone the release. We fully understand that some of you might be angry about that. But we also believe that, in the end, nobody wins when we release an incomplete game on time. We owe it to you to give this game a satisfying conclusion and we believe this is what most of you want us to do as well.

With all that being said, we now target a release of CrossCode in [b]Early 2018[/b]. Yes, this is big step, but this should give us enough time to finish the story and make sure it reaches a satisfying conclusion. It will hopefully be the last time we have to postpone the release to such an extend. 

Since it will be another half a year, we plan to add a few more releases in-between with more content to play.

[h1]New Release Schedule[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/release-schedule-600x368.jpg[/img]

[b]CrossCode 0.9.5[/b]
Release Date: [b]June 2017[/b]

This update will [b]finally[/b] extend the story! By quite a bit as well. It will slightly expand locations around Maroon Valley, Rookie Harbor and Autumn's Fall, include several smaller boss battles and plenty of interesting plot developments. It may also be leaving you wanting more story, so be warned.

Includes:
[list]
[*]More Story[/*]
[*]More Quests[/*]
[/list]

[b]CrossCode 0.9.7[/b]
Release Date: [b]Autumn 2017[/b]

This release will add the new area [b]Sapphire Ridge[/b] with new enemies and puzzles included. You may recognize the area from another part of the game you've already played.
We'll also finally work on all those [b]backer perks[/b] we promised back during our Indiegogo campaign.

Includes:
[list]
[*]New Area: Sapphire Ridge[/*]
[*]More Quests[/*]
[*]First Backer Food / NPCs / Quests / Enemies[/*]
[/list]


[b]CrossCode 0.9.9[/b]
Release Date: [b]End of 2017[/b]

This release will implement the new [b]level 3 combat arts[/b] so you can try those out and give us feedback for balancing!
You will also, for the first time, be able to enter Rhombus Square. You might only be able to enter certain parts of the city in the beginning, but we intend to expand the place over time, even beyond the 1.0 release.

Includes:
[list]
[*]Level 3 Combat Arts[/*]
[*]New City: Rhombus Square[/*]
[*]More Quests[/*]
[*]More Backer Food / NPCs / Quest / Enemies[/*]
[/list]

[b]CrossCode 1.0[/b]
Release Date: [b]Early 2018[/b]

This will be the big release of the full version! It will include a (hopefully) satisfying conclusion to the story.

Includes:
[list]
[*]Full Story[/*]
[*]Complete Skill Tree[/*]
[*]Indiegogo Backer Food / NPCs / Quest / Enemies (maybe not complete)[/*]
[*]More Quests[/*]
[/list]

Note that versions 0.9.7 and 0.9.9 will have less content compared to previous releases. That's because a lot of content for the final version will be developed in parallel to those versions but only released with the full game.

[b]Post Release Content[/b]

Of course we still plan to develop the game beyond it's final release adding more post-game content and remaining backer perks we didn't manage to implement on time.

This includes:
[list]
[*]New Game+[/*]
[*]All remaining Indiegogo Backer Content[/*]
[*]A Battle Arena in Rhombus Square with a lot of different challenges[/*]
[*]More Quests[/*]
[/list]

And this is our new schedule! Again we're very sorry we have to postpone the release once again, but we really hope that all the wait will be worth it in the end!

[h1]Localization[/h1]

Two weeks ago, we released the [b]Chinese Localization[/b] with help of our partner [b]WhisperGames[/b].

We are now also happy to announce that we're working on a [b]Japanese Localization[/b] with our new partner [url=http://dangenentertainment.com]Dangen Entertainment[/url] to be released sometime during Early Access, possibly with version 0.9.7.

Now many of you asked for translation into other languages, be it Russian, Spanish, French etc. We're still in the process of looking for potential partners for some of these languages, but if nothing comes up, we do plan to [b]involve the community[/b] to help up translate CrossCode to other languages. However, we plan to start those [b]community translations[/b] later once we're closer to the version 1.0. This is mostly because working with more people to translate the game early on may further distract us from developing the game itself and we really don't want to keep postponing the release!

[h1]Back from BitSummit[/h1]


[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/logo.png[/img]

We're back from [b]BitSummit[/b] in Kyoto, Japan and man... what an event.

We met a lot of other cool developers including [url=http://www.konjak.org/]Konjak[/url] (Iconoclast), [url=http://bombservice.com/]Bomb Service[/url] (Momodora), [url=https://kayin.moe/]Kayin[/url] (Brave Earth: Prologue), and [url=http://stellarjockeys.com]Stellar Jockeys[/url] (Brigador) among many others!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/bitsummit-1-600x450.jpg[/img]
Our CrossCode booth got a lot of visitors by all kind of folks... and also the [b]press[/b]!

And now you we nice articles by [url=http://jp.ign.com/crosscode/13779/preview/rpgcrosscode]IGN Japan[/url] and [url=http://www.ign.com/articles/2017/05/29/18-sweet-games-we-played-at-this-years-bitsummit]IGN USA[/url]! There was also a [b]Famitsu articles[/b] that disappeared... but maybe it'll show up again!

Traveling all the way to Japan was quite exhausting and so was standing at the booth all day long, but overall it was definitely worth it and we'd gladly do it again next year!
We also want to say thanks to Dangen Entertainment for organizing a great deal of the whole thing and taking good care of us in general!

[h1]See you at Dokomi![/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/dokomi-300x243.png[/img]

This Saturday and Sunday we'll be at Dokomi in Düsseldorf, Germany presenting CrossCode! You'll find us in [b]Hall 4, Booth L12[/b]! If you're there, feel free to drop by, say "Hi!" and get a sticker!

notes.title: 2 Years Early Access + Release Schedule Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/crosscode-schedule-2017-1-600x455.jpg[/img]
Woah, has it really been 2 years already? Indeed: CrossCode started Early Access back in May 2015. To celebrate the occasion we have a [b]Daily Deal[/b] today on Steam!

Now before some of you might be tempted to take the offer we thought it would be fair to talk about the ever-so-important question: 
[b]When is CrossCode finally finished?[/b]

Back in 2016 we posted our [url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/?p=5274]release schedule[/url] and at that time, we estimated the final release for [b]June-September 2017[/b]. We're now very close at this date and unfortunately see that there is still [b]too much left to do[/b]. Yes, most major locations and dungeons have been finished and you can already gather all 4 elements. The only major thing that is now missing is the [b]story[/b]. And story is difficult. It's important to us that the plot will leave enough space for character development, will be able to surprise you and most important of all: will have a satisfying conclusion. All of this unfortunately takes time, more than we estimated.

[b]The only way we could release on time would be by cutting content[/b], making the game shorter than intended. This will of course leave the final product lacking and we really want to avoid this.

The good news is: [b]financially we can afford to develop the game until it reaches the intended conclusion[/b]. That of course means we have to postpone the release. We fully understand that some of you might be angry about that. But we also believe that, in the end, nobody wins when we release an incomplete game on time. We owe it to you to give this game a satisfying conclusion and we believe this is what most of you want us to do as well.

With all that being said, we now target a release of CrossCode in [b]Early 2018[/b]. Yes, this is big step, but this should give us enough time to finish the story and make sure it reaches a satisfying conclusion. It will hopefully be the last time we have to postpone the release to such an extend. 

Since it will be another half a year, we plan to add a few more releases in-between with more content to play.

We'll also finally work on all those [b]backer perks[/b] we promised back during our Indiegogo campaign.

Includes:
[list]

[*]More Quests[/*]
[*]First Backer Food / NPCs / Quests / Enemies[/*]
[/list]


[b]CrossCode 0.9.9[/b]
Release Date: [b]End of 2017[/b]

This release will implement the new [b]level 3 combat arts[/b] so you can try those out and give us feedback for balancing!
You will also, for the first time, be able to enter Rhombus Square. You might only be able to enter certain parts of the city in the beginning, but we intend to expand the place over time, even beyond the 1.0 release.

Includes:
[list]

[*]More Quests[/*]
[*]More Backer Food / NPCs / Quest / Enemies[/*]
[/list]

[b]CrossCode 1.0[/b]
Release Date: [b]Early 2018[/b]

This will be the big release of the full version! It will include a (hopefully) satisfying conclusion to the story.

notes.title: CrossCode 0.9.2 with Chinese Localization + Faster Startup!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/chinese-release-header-600x297.jpg[/img]

We got a small little update for you! CrossCode version 0.9.2 now features a [b]complete Chinese translation[/b] done by [url=http://weibo.com/whisperstudio]WhisperGames[/url]! 

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/titlescreen-600x338.png[/img]Chinese on the title screen. Such nice characters.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/dialog-600x338.png[/img]Chinese dialogs. I can't read anything.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/menu-600x338.png[/img]Chinese menus. Yupp. This reminds me of old times when I tried to play imported RPGs.

...So yeah! Let's hope that WhisperGames does a good job with the localization! It's not like we can check it! :D

Another change: CrossCode should now [b]start much faster[/b]. Previously, all game assets have been shipped in an archive that had to be fully extracted before the game could start. Not only did this take long it also spammed your hard drives with the extracted files over and over again. Yeah, that was a bad idea. Sorry for that! Anyway, this is a thing of the past and from now on CrossCode should start right away without any archive extraction!

Oh... and in case you're wondering about other localizations: we're about to fly to Kyoto, Japan to attend [url=http://bitsummit.org/2017/]BitSummit[/url] so maybe you can guess what other translation we're currently working on...

And that's all! Now let's wrap up this post with Lea wearing a cheongsam!
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/chinese-release-600x1009.png[/img]

再见！

notes.title: Hi-Lights + Upcoming Events
notes.notes:
We're about to enter May so it's time to talk about recent progress and upcoming releases!

[h1]New Game Artwork and Logo[/h1]

Something we've been working on for quiet some time now is finally done. Introducing: [b]the new game artwork[/b]:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/poster-hd-600x437.jpg[/img]

We decided to go for a different theme compared to the previous artwork, focusing on different characters. We also put a lot more effort into the whole thing overall!

You also might notice that we changed the [b]Logo[/b] of the game to something that stands out a little bit more. We plan to adapt the logo inside the game as well.

[h1]Development Progress[/h1]

CrossCode Version 0.9.5 was originally scheduled to be released sometime April to May this year. This version will add [b]a big chunk of story[/b] that will cover the whole Maroon Valley, Faj'ro Temple, as well as Autumn's Fall. Now as it turned out... developing this story and everything connected to it took longer than expected. That's why we most likely won't be able to finish version 0.9.5 in time. The way things look right now we might have to postpone the release by another month to [b]June 2017[/b]. Of course, the release of version 1.0, originally scheduled for June-September 2017, will likely also be impacted by that.

That of course doesn't mean nothing happened. To the contrary! Here some impressions of recent development:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/element-mode-effects.gif[/img]
We started adding new effects when changing your element mode.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/maroon-tree-cave-1-600x342.png[/img]
We finally finished that [b]Maroon Tree Quest[/b]...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/maroon-tree-cave-2-600x356.png[/img]
...including a lot of battles against those sand worms.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/random-cutscene-dialog-2-600x338.png[/img]
Some more stuff happening in Ba'kii Kum! Who might they be talking about?

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/story-1-600x338.png[/img]
Our party finally reaching Faj'ro Temple...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/story-3-600x338.png[/img]
...and the new area at the top of Faj'ro Temple!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/dream-waterfall-600x338.png[/img]
Also included: more dreams!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/box-pushing-quest-600x338.png[/img]
Something else we're working on: Quests. More Box pushing!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/sensei-quest-600x338.png[/img]
And here we have the comeback of the infamous target bots! Note that this quest is still heavily WIP.

In addition to that [b]Intero[/b] has worked on several new music tracks!

[list]
[*]The [url=https://twitter.com/interovgm/status/836333376693026816]Casual Theme[/url] that we already sneaked into the 0.9 release[/*]
[*]The [url=https://twitter.com/interovgm/status/844540035106050048]New Battle Theme[/url] playing when fighting enemies outdoors with your party.[/*]
[*]The [url=https://twitter.com/interovgm/status/852311642096496641]Briefing Theme[/url] playing during exposition scenes - like the Major of Bergen explaining the situation.[/*]
[*]Another [url=https://twitter.com/interovgm/status/857997438287851520]Cutscene Theme[/url] playing during certain... cutscenes.[/*]
[/list]

[h1]Upcoming Events[/h1]

In 2016 we focused 100% on development and essentially [b]stayed home permanently, working[/b] with the exception of a few CrossWeeks maybe. Or at least somewhat like that.
Now in 2017 we're getting close to finishing the game so we thought it's about time to start visiting some Event to promote CrossCode!

Thus here two upcoming events we'll be attending within the next two month:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/logo.png[/img]
We'll be attending [url=http://bitsummit.org/2017/]bitSummit[/url] from May 20-21 in [b]Kyoto, Japan[/b]!

And two weeks later, not quite as far away:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/dokomi-300x243.png[/img] 
We'll also attend [url=https://www.dokomi.de]Dokomi[/url] from June 3-4 in [b]Düsseldorf, Germany[/b]!

If you happen to be around, feel free to drop by and say hello! We might also bring a little bit of CrossCode Merch with us!

And that's all for now!
And sorry that things take a bit longer once again.

notes.title: CrossCode now with Voice Acting!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/version-up-0.9.1-600x349.jpg[/img]


[b]Note: the Voice Acting Feature was a prank for April Fools Day. Read more about it at the end of the post[/b]

Today we have a very special release for you! CrossCode version 0.9.1 now adds [b]Voice Acting[/b] for most of the main characters. That's right: You can now listen to the voice of Lea, Emilie, Sergey, Apollo and many other characters!

CrossCode is all about its characters and their story. Giving those characters a voice has the potential to further elevate the whole experience - if done right! That's why we took extra care to assemble the most qualified team of professional voice actors. 

And so we proudly present:

You can use the same code to disable it again. Also note that Voice Acting will always be disabled by default when you restart the application.

notes.title: CrossCode 0.9 Final Jungle Temple + C'Tron + Quests
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/version-up-0.9-600x349.jpg[/img]
It's done! Just in time. Today we release [b]CrossCode Version 0.9[/b] as promised in [b]February[/b]! This updates comes with another [b]new dungeon[/b], a very big [b]circuit update[/b], a new [b]party member[/b], lots of [b]quests[/b] and many, many more features, improvements, and additions!

[h1]Grand Krys'kajo - The final temple of the Jungle[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/first-interior-done-2-600x338.png[/img]
With the [b]Grand Krys'kajo[/b] we release the final temple of Gaia's Garden. Being the follow up dungeon after the So'najiz and Zir'vitar Temple it will combine puzzle mechanics from both dungeons and finish things off with an epic boss fight! Boss fight... are you thinking contest? That's right! Read more about it further below.

[h1]Level 2 Combat Arts[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/new-hit-numbers.gif[/img]
The circuit made a pretty big leap with this update: [b]all passive skill, as well as level 1 and level 2 Combat Arts have been fully implemented[/b]. That means the circuit is pretty much complete with the exception of level 3 combat arts. Since so many things changed, you'll get the option to reset your skill tree when you load your old save.

Also: we added a new [b]Practice Arena[/b] in the Info Building of Rookie Harbor! You can practice all the Combat Arts to your heart's content without being limited by SP costs.

[h1]C'Tron - Now ready to join your Party[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/ctron-party-2-600x338.png[/img]
C'Tron is now finally ready to join party! When you reach the current end of the story, C'Tron will send you a message, allowing you to invite him to your party via the [b]Social Menu[/b]. This will also work with old save states. Note: C'Tron is currently only there for you to enjoy the gameplay with a 3rd party member - scenes and plenty of chit-chat will be added later.

But that's not all! Party Members are now much more capable in general, as they will start using [b]elements[/b] and [b]combat arts[/b] during battle - and are less likely to fall into water... a bit. You also now have more options for your party's behavior via the new and shiny [b]strategy menu[/b]!

[h1]Lots of new Quests[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/new-quests-1-600x338.png[/img]
This update has Quests. Many Quests. 8 of them. You'll find them in Bergen Village, Maroon Valley, Ba'kii Kum, and Basin Keep. They come with many new boss fights, mini games, and other cool challenges! So make sure to keep an eye out for those flashing exclamation marks!

[h1]New Help Menu[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/help-menu-600x338.png[/img]
Remember when you used to look at a trading offer, trying to figure out what a certain modifier does? [b]Help Menu to the rescue[/b]! With a simple button press you now can see on screen explanations for all kind of menu content, including stats, modifiers, and many other things. The new help menu is available in most menu views, including Trading, Shopping, Equipment, Inventory, and many more.

[h1]Other Stuff[/h1]

This update packs a lot of smaller cool features that are also worth mentioning

[list]
 	[*]A improve display when [b]Swapping Circuit Branches[/b]. You can actually see the skills you will exchange.[/*]
 	[*]A new SP bar that allows you to quickly see your current SP without moving your eyes away from the player[/*]
 	[*]Total Damage Number for each enemy to better estimate the amount of damage you deal - pretty much inspired by what PixelFerrets did in [b]Secret of Grindea[/b][/*]
 	[*]An improved stun system that solves a few frustrating counter-attack moments (looking at you, Apollo) and allows the player to escape a long chain of combos[/*]
 	[*]Changed order of menu buttons! The Quest Menu is now much easier to reach.[/*]
 	[*]New Buff stacking behavior: your number of concurrent buff now starts with 1 and can be extended with the appetite skill. Also: you can start a new buff at any time while buffs with overlapping stat improvement will cancel each other out.[/*]
        [*]No more unlimited combat art charging. Sorry, but this was never intended to be a feature![/*]
[/list]

[h1]Contest: Beat the Boss of the Grand Krys'kajo![/h1]

This is possibly our [b]final boss contest[/b] before the full release!

[b]Show us how you beat the boss of the Grand Krys'kajo[/b]!

Just create a [b]public video[/b] (Youtube, Twitch, doesn’t matter) and send us a link to [b]contest@radicalfishgames.com[/b].
You can add your live reaction or leave it out, whatever you prefer!

Among all people who send us a video, we’ll draw the following prize:
[b]You get your personal NPC guest role somewhere in CrossWorlds - you decide the location[/b]! You can be an Avatar, a regular citizen or maybe something else? We’ll work together to figure out the details!
[b]Deadline: Sunday, March 5, 23:59 PDT[/b]

Phews! That's all.
Have fun with the new release and make sure to beat up that new boss for good!

And now comes the time of [b]Bug hunting[/b].

[h1]Hotfix 0.9.0-3 released[/h1]

We released Hotfix 0.9.0-3 that should fix a number of issues, including crashes when talking to NPCs, crashes during Jet's Tutorial and more.

This update has Quests. Many Quests. 8 of them. You'll find them in Bergen Village, Maroon Valley, Ba'kii Kum, and Basin Keep. They come with many new boss fights, mini games, and other cool challenges! So make sure to keep an eye out for those flashing exclamation marks!

[h1]New Help Menu[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/help-menu-600x338.png[/img]
Remember when you used to look at a trading offer, trying to figure out what a certain modifier does? [b]Help Menu to the rescue[/b]! With a simple button press you now can see on screen explanations for all kind of menu content, including stats, modifiers, and many other things. The new help menu is available in most menu views, including Trading, Shopping, Equipment, Inventory, and many more.

[h1]Other Stuff[/h1]

This update packs a lot of smaller cool features that are also worth mentioning

[list]
 	[*]A improve display when [b]Swapping Circuit Branches[/b]. You can actually see the skills you will exchange.[/*]
 	[*]A new SP bar that allows you to quickly see your current SP without moving your eyes away from the player[/*]
 	[*]Total Damage Number for each enemy to better estimate the amount of damage you deal - pretty much inspired by what PixelFerrets did in [b]Secret of Grindea[/b][/*]
 	[*]An improved stun system that solves a few frustrating counter-attack moments (looking at you, Apollo) and allows the player to escape a long chain of combos[/*]
 	[*]Changed order of menu buttons! The Quest Menu is now much easier to reach.[/*]
 	[*]New Buff stacking behavior: your number of concurrent buff now starts with 1 and can be extended with the appetite skill. Also: you can start a new buff at any time while buffs with overlapping stat improvement will cancel each other out.[/*]
        [*]No more unlimited combat art charging. Sorry, but this was never intended to be a feature![/*]
[/list]

[h1]Contest: Beat the Boss of the Grand Krys'kajo![/h1]

This is possibly our [b]final boss contest[/b] before the full release!

[b]Show us how you beat the boss of the Grand Krys'kajo[/b]!

Just create a [b]public video[/b] (Youtube, Twitch, doesn’t matter) and send us a link to [b]contest@radicalfishgames.com[/b].
You can add your live reaction or leave it out, whatever you prefer!

Among all people who send us a video, we’ll draw the following prize:
[b]You get your personal NPC guest role somewhere in CrossWorlds - you decide the location[/b]! You can be an Avatar, a regular citizen or maybe something else? We’ll work together to figure out the details!
[b]Deadline: Sunday, March 5, 23:59 PDT[/b]

Phews! That's all.
Have fun with the new release and make sure to beat up that new boss for good!

And now comes the time of [b]Bug hunting[/b].

[h1]Hotfix 0.9.0-3 released[/h1]

We released Hotfix 0.9.0-3 that should fix a number of issues, including crashes when talking to NPCs, crashes during Jet's Tutorial and more.
