notes.title: 5th CrossWeek Completed!
notes.notes:
The 5th CrossWeek just happened and after 6 days of intensive full-time CrossCode development we're now back with a lot of new stuff to show!

[h1]More enemies[/h1]

We did a lot of planning for upcoming enemies and created plenty of concept art:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/bug-samurai-twitter-600x569.jpg[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/snail-twitter-600x471.jpg[/img]

Additionally, [b]sprite sheets[/b] for several new enemies have been completed and are just waiting to be implemented!

[h1]More Quests[/h1]

Quests have been pretty big this CrossWeek! A total of 4 new quests have been implemented for Bergen and Ba'kii Kum, featuring several new enemies and other challenges! 

Here some impressions of things you might fight:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/guard-battle-600x338.png[/img]

Guards.

https://gfycat.com/FancySatisfiedBird

Penguins.

[h1]New Lea Combat Poses[/h1]

We recently pushed Combat Arts pretty hard and essentially implemented [b]all level 1 and level 2 Combat Arts[/b] available.
This CrossWeek, we took a bit of time to polish those attacks with a few additional poses for Lea:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/lea-combt-art-poses.gif[/img]

[h1]NPC Portraits[/h1]

The current grayish NPC portraits don't quite match the quality of the colored counterpart. We can't really afford to give each and every NPC a full-colored portrait, but we at least decided to polish the grayish NPC portraits to be a better match quality wise:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/new-generic-npcs-600x338.png[/img]

[h1]More Sounds[/h1]

A lot of sounds have been added to things that have been surprisingly quite up to this point. Now you have [b]groaning Behesloths[/b] and [b]meowing Shokats[/b] that will make you feel real bad for beating them up.

Also, you now find a lot of random melodies in Basin Keep:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0678Tv0O0rc

[h1]The Final Boss of the Jungle[/h1]

Yepp, we've been working on the boss, and nope we won't show anything of it. Let's just say it will be... something else. Seriously, we might have overdone it a bit this time, which is also why this fight is still not done yet!


[h1]Behind the scenes[/h1]

Who cares for the actual game content, right? 
We know exactly what you want to see: 
[b]A bunch of dudes doing gamedev and trying to cook.[/b]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/task-distribution-600x797.jpeg[/img]
Fair task distribution

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/at-work-600x337.jpg[/img]
Hard at work! In the kitchen.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/IMG_2103-600x450.jpg[/img]
GFluegel creating the next quest you'll all love.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/IMG_2111-600x450.jpg[/img]
A random Intero dropping by!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/IMG_2104-600x800.jpg[/img]
Preparing Bacon...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/IMG_2106-600x800.jpg[/img]
...for our Veggie burgers.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/IMG_2112-1-600x800.jpg[/img]
Also for our rice balls / Onigiri. Yes.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/IMG_2110-final-600x440.jpg[/img]
The team enjoying some burgers, probably with less bacon but still very tasty!

And that's all for CrossWeek! It was fun, it was productive and we'll probably do it again, sometime later this year!

Now on to wrap things up for the [b]0.9 release[/b] which is still scheduled for [b]later this month[/b].

Until then!

notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/highlight-17-01-26-600x334.png[/img]

Welcome to the year 2017, everyball! Yeah it's about time we do another update post. We'll show some [b]recent progress[/b], got the [b]results[/b] of the recent [b]Boss Contest[/b] for you and other great news as well!

[h1]Recent Progress[/h1]
The next version [b]0.9.0[/b] is scheduled for Release in [b]February[/b]. Not only will this version include the [b]last dungeon of the Jungle[/b] with another epic boss fight, it will also finally include the [b]complete circuit tree[/b] for all elements with all skills fully implemented, with the exception of Level 3 combat arts.
And yes, that means you'll get [b]all level 1 and level 2 combat arts available[/b]!
That's a lot of combat options at your disposal!


[b]GET READY FOR LOTS OF GIFS[/b]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/lea-more-skills.gif[/img]
Some of the remaining level 1 combat arts that have still been missing.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/final-showdown.gif[/img]
Entering Neutral Level 2! This is "Final Showdown" the successor of "First Cut".

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/lea-lvl2-madness.gif[/img]
More Level 2 Neutral Combat Art Madness!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/freeze-frame.gif[/img]
Entering Cold Level 2! Now Lea can downright [b]freeze[/b] enemies.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/lea-cold-lvl2-melee.gif[/img]
Alternatively, just freeze'em while pushing them upwards!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/lea-heat-lvl2.gif[/img]
Entering Heat Level 2! Some of those attacks might remind you of something~

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/chain-lightning.gif[/img]
Entering Shock Level 2! As requested by many, we added the almost mandatory "chain lightning" attack.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/lea-lvl2-shock-dash.gif[/img]
Shock also features some other attacks that are just incredibly fast.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/new-hit-numbers.gif[/img]
In fact, some of these attacks have been so fast hitting, that the mass of damage numbers became sort of a problem. That's why we decided to add damage summaries and limited the number of damage numbers that can appear simultaneously for each enemies.

[b]We also worked on party members![/b]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/emilie-shock-arts.gif[/img]
Emilie now can use Combat Arts, too!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/ctron-combat.gif[/img]
And finally: say hello to your new Hexacast companion C'Tron!


Apart from combat stuff, we also worked on [b]several new Quests[/b] in Basin Keep and Ba'kii Kum - some of which might surprise you with entirely new tasks!

[h1]So'najiz Boss Contest Results[/h1]

With the release of Version [b]0.8[/b] we once again held a contest for everyone to beat the new boss [b]within a week[/b] and record it in a public video.
And we got a whole of [b]36 submissions[/b]!

notes.title: CrossCode 0.8.5 More Dungeon and Exploring!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/version-up-0.8.5-600x349.jpg[/img]

With the holidays almost at our doors, it's time to get comfy and play some CrossCode. And what's better to go along with this than a [b]new update[/b]? Even though this is not a "new number"-Release this update packs a lot of content so let's check them all out, shall we?


[h1]Final part of Gaia's Garden unlocked[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/jungle-clearing-600x338.png[/img]

South-East of Gaia's Garden lies a small [b]Shad settlement[/b] which is now accessible for exploring. However, you might find yourself to be an unwanted guest. What could have happened here? Note: This region will get more Story through optional quest in later updates.

[h1]So'Najiz Temple aka The Wave Temple[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/sonajiz-temple.gif[/img]

West of the [b]Rite of Passage[/b] inside Gaia's Garden you can now enter the So'Najiz Temple which will not only give you access to the [b]Shock Element[/b] but also the final key to open all those golden chests! Oh did we mention this is an underwater temple? Really the best place for an avatar to be, don't you think so too?

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/lea-this-is-fine-sonajiz-600x279.jpg[/img]

[h1]Shock Element[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/shock-arts.gif[/img]

The [b]final element[/b] is finally here. While Wave was an element designed to help you with healing buffs or pushing away foes, this one is all about quick attacks and fast movements.

[h1]Basin Keep Extension[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/basin-keep-east-600x338.png[/img]

Both the west and east maps of Basin Keep are now accessible. While the west area is home to many high-society residents, the east one is a problematic region for the city in many ways. Both of these maps are already quite far ahead and we wanted people to see them but they will get more NPCs and quests too. You might already find some chests you can't access right now. Look out for a special quest in the eastern part in later updates!

[h1]Other Stuff[/h1]

Like always we made a lot of smaller adjustments or additions. Here's a quick list of most new things:
[list]
 	[*]All chests that required keys now have special graphics making them stick out more. The same is true for chests that contain keys found inside dungeons.[/*]
 	[*]We reworked positional sounds! No more distant splash sounds. We also added a bunch of environmental sounds like waterfalls for instance.[/*]
 	[*]Find new Quests in Ba'kii Kum![/*]
 	[*]The trade menu now always shows the stats for a piece of equipment on the left side at all times.[/*]
 	[*]Extended German Translation![/*]
        [*]New Background Music for So'Najiz AND Zir'Vitar Temple![/*]
[/list]

[h1]Contest: Beat the Boss of So'Najiz Temple![/h1]

And another [b]contest[/b] for you!

[b]Show us how you beat the boss of So'Najiz Temple[/b]!

Just create a [b]public video[/b] (Youtube, Twitch, doesn’t matter) and send us a link to [b]contest@radicalfishgames.com[/b].
You can add your live reaction or leave it out, whatever you prefer!

And just so you know who the boss is... it's in [b]this room[/b]:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/sonajiz-boss-room-600x338.png[/img]

Among all people who send us the video, we’ll draw the following prize:
[b]You get your personal NPC guest role in Basin Keep or the Shad Village in Gaia's Garden[/b]! You can be an Avatar, a regular citizen or maybe something else? We’ll work together to figure out the details!
[b]Deadline: Sunday, December 18, 23:59 PDT[/b]

Aaand... that's all!
Have fun with the new release!

Time to switch to [b]Bug Fighting Mode[/b] then. Tell us if you find any!

notes.title: Release Schedule and more!
notes.notes:
Hello everyball! 

So November is about to end and some of you are probably waiting for news about the [b]next update[/b]. Well, here they are! And not only that, we also plan to talk about [b]planned future updates[/b] and finally answer the big question: [b]When will there be more Story[/b]?

[h1]Release Schedule[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/release-schedule-600x368.jpg[/img]

The following is an [b]estimate[/b] of the future release schedule. Note that there is of course no guarantee that we release all that on time - game development is hard after all. But we'll try our best to stay close to it. So here goes!

[b]CrossCode 0.8.5[/b]
Release Date: [b]December 13, 2016[/b]

The next update will further extend the jungle!

Includes:
[list]
[*]So’najiz Temple - the Wave Dungeon[/*]
[*]Shock Mode[/*]
[*]Final Jungle Area[/*]
[*]Extended Basin Keep[/*]
[*]More Quests[/*]
[/list]

[b]CrossCode 0.9.0[/b]
Release Date: [b]February 2017[/b]

This update will finally complete the jungle and also include a lot gameplay additions and improvements - like way more skills and combat arts!

Includes:
[list]
[*]Grand Krys’kajo - The Final Dungeon of the Jungle[/*]
[*]More Party Members that will also use Elements and Combat Arts[/*]
[*]More Combats Arts (at least all level 1 and 2 arts)[/*]
[*]Most Passive Skills Implemented[/*]
[*]More Quests[/*]
[/list]

[b]CrossCode 0.9.5[/b]
Release Date: [b]April-May 2017[/b]

This update will [b]finally[/b] extend the story and also add a smaller area (comparable to Autumn's Fall).
If we'll manage to get it done, you'll also be able to enter Rhombus Square for the first time!

Includes:
[list]
[*]Finally more story[/*]
[*]A new area[/*]
[*]Maybe: Rhombus Square[/*]
[*]More Quests[/*]
[/list]

[b]CrossCode 1.0[/b]
Release Date: [b]June-September 2017[/b]

This will be the big release of the full version! It will include an (hopefully) satisfying conclusion to the story.

Includes:
[list]
[*]Full Story[/*]
[*]Complete Skill Tree[/*]
[*]Indiegogo Backer NPCs, Quests and enemies (maybe not complete)[/*]
[*]More Quests[/*]
[/list]

[b]Post Release Content[/b]

But wait! That's not all. We made a lot of promises back during the Indiegogo campaign and since it will be hard to deliver all of this with 1.0 we plan to update the game beyond the "full release" for additional end-game content and more!

This includes:
[list]
[*]New Game+[/*]
[*]All remaining Indiegogo Backer Content[/*]
[*]A Battle Arena in Rhombus Square with a lot of different challenges[/*]
[*]More Quests[/*]
[/list]


So looking at this release schedule I'm sure some of you have questions!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/ama-small-600x277.jpg[/img]

[b]I want more story already! Why do you release more story so late?[/b]
Because cliffhangers! The story of CrossCode may seem fairly relaxed so far, but things won't stay that way. When we continue the story further, there will be plot twists and other surprises. And then you'll have to wait. So instead of letting you wait half a year, we thought we'd try to reduce it to a few month by just releasing the story close to the final version. We just hope to deliver the best experience of the story that way! Also: The additional time really helps us to polish things up to the end to have the best final result without changing too much during development.

[b]Didn't you plan to finish the Jungle back in October? Now it's even further postponed to 2017.[/b]
Yes, things again took a bit longer than expected, partly due to illness of team members. But there is another reason as well: the jungle will be the last big area and following that we will mostly focus on implementing missing features such as skills and maybe more quests. And of course, lots of content for the story we can't release because [b]spoilers[/b]. That's why we thought it would be good to kind of spread the content of the jungle over the next few releases instead of releasing everything at once. 
Also: More Boss Contests!

[b]Is the Jungle Dungeon the last dungeon? Will the game just end after this?[/b]
Yes and no. The dungeons of the Jungle Area are the last "proper" dungeons. However, the game will not simply end after that, more stuff will happen. There will be more puzzles (though not of the density of a proper dungeon), more boss fights and in general a lot of exciting stuff! But we won't spoil things!

[b]So wait... Wasn't the release planned for Q2 or even Q1 2017? And now it's September - postponed again?[/b]
Well, sorta. If things go perfectly, we might be able to hit June for the final release, which is end of Q2, strictly speaking. We might miss that deadline though, mostly because the Jungle area took quite a bit longer than estimated. In the end, we'll try to stay close to our release schedule, but when it comes down to it, what is most important to us is a good end result. If it turns out that we need bit more time to really properly conclude the story, we'll take that time.

[b]Will there be More Quests?[/b]

There will always be [b]More Quests[/b].

Anything else we didn't cover with this set of entirely fictional questions? Please ask ahead!

[h1]Recent Progress[/h1]

Okay, so here is what we've been up to recently!

[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/clearing-1.png][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/clearing-1-600x338.png[/img][/url]
Visit the new area of the jungle...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/mapping-progress3.gif[/img]
... enter the Wave Dungeon...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/enemy-rooms.gif[/img]
... defeat all the threats...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/shock-element-get.gif[/img]
... to finally collect the last element!

[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/first-interior-done.png][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/first-interior-done-600x338.png[/img][/url]
Also in development and hopefully ready next year: the final dungeon of the Jungle!

[h1]Steam Awards[/h1]
Oh boy, it's the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/SteamAwardNominations/]Steam Awards[/url], would you look at this! Maybe [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/368340/]CrossCode[/url] can have one of those? That “I Thought This Game Was Cool Before It Won An Award” Award looks so shiny!

You can still vote until [b]November 29[/b]!

Also, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/368340/]CrossCode is currently on sale![/url]

[h1]Gamedev Stream[/h1]

We'll have another stream [b]tonight[/b]!
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/lea-stream-winter-600x368.jpg[/img]

We will try to implement some of the [b]Shock Combat Arts[/b], answer your questions and probably do a drawing again!
You can watch it here: [url=http://twitch.tv/radicalfishgames]twitch.tv/radicalfishgames[/url]
Time: 20:00 CET / 11 am PST

And that's all, until next time!

notes.title: CrossCode 0.8.3 - Happy Halloween!
notes.notes:
[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/version-up-0.8.3.jpg][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/version-up-0.8.3-600x348.jpg[/img][/url]

The title says it all: Happy Halloween! And what's best to go along with it? A new CrossCode update of course. And this time it's a rather spooky one! Let's get into the new additions right away.

[h1]Botanics Menu[/h1]

[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/bb.png][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/bb-600x338.png[/img][/url]
Another community requested feature is now available making it possible for you to track what plants drop what item and where you can find them. However it's not that simple. A new NPC emerged in Autumn's Rise which requires your help to analyze the Flora of CrossWorlds. Hit plants and collect drops. Each drop increases your progress for each plant. Can you find them all?

[h1]Infested Jungle[/h1]

[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/infested-3.png][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/infested-3-600x338.png[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/infested-2.png][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/infested-2-600x338.png[/img][/url]
The infested jungle region of Gaia's Garden is now unlocked and can be accessed in the north-eastern part of the area. Make sure to be ready as the region is full of narrow passages and dangerous foes.

Gaia's Garden and Basin Keep now also have their own music!


[h1]A Scary Surprise[/h1]

[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/boogie.png][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/boogie-600x338.png[/img][/url]
In Basin Keep a strange business man seems to be in dire need of your help. Make sure to pay him a visit!

Other than that we fixed a lot of smaller issues and balanced skills and items. You can get the full picture by checking out the changelog in-game.

Now go download the new update and get ready to be scared!

Until next time!

notes.title: CrossCode 0.8 Release!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/version-up-0.8-600x348.jpg[/img]
We did it! After a very long "Saturday" we proudly release: 
[b]CrossCode Version 0.8[/b]!

We'll keep this short, because really, you probably just want to play the game and we want to get some sleep! But just so you know, we also have a [b]contest[/b] for you. More about that at the end!

[h1]New Areas and Dungeons[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/autumns-fall-600x338.png[/img][b]Autumns' Fall[/b], the new area to the northeast of Rookie Harbor, filled with ancient ruins!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/jungle-grove-600x338.png[/img]Beyond that lies the jungle [b]Gaia's Garden[/b] - easily the biggest area of the game, alas not 100% done as of now. Still a lot of land to explore!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/basin-keep-600x338.png[/img]In the middle of the jungle you will find [b]Basin Keep[/b] - a bustling city that is, as of now, not yet 100% bustling, but we'll get there, promised! Still you can enter it and "enjoy" the rainy atmosphere!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/temple-entrance-600x338.png[/img]Further beyond, hidden in the deep end of the jungle you will find the great dungeon of the [b]Grand Krys’kajo[/b], consisting of 3 smaller sub dungeons. As of now 1 of these 3 sub dungeons is finished: 

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/zir-vitar-temple-600x338.png[/img]The [b]Zir'vitar Temple[/b]! Expect a whole bunch of new puzzles and enemies, including a boss fight. Mind that this dungeon is not as long as the Faj'ro Temple and Temple Mine (because it's 1/3 of the whole thing), but still comes with the usual challenges!

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/wave-arts.gif[/img]
With the new dungeon, you of course get a new element mode. The [b]Wave Element[/b], complete with 5 new combat arts!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/status-all-small1.gif[/img]
Enter the [b]Status Menu[/b]! Finally you can read all about your stats and modifiers with all the nitty gritty details!

[h1]Other Things[/h1]

There is more!

[list]
[*][b]New Quests[/b] in Rookie Harbor and Bergen, including another [i]lovely[/i] monk quest![/*]
[*]The first [b]Level 2 combat art[/b]! So far there is only one and you find it in the [b]Neutral Tree[/b] down the [b]Melee branch[/b]. This is still experimental, but please give it a try! It consumes [b]3 SP[/b] - simply charge for a longer time![/*]
[*]All the enemies now [b]respawn in all the dungeons[/b]![/*]
[*]A long list of smaller fixes and changes! Just take a look at that changelog. It's long. Really long.[/*]
[/list]

[h1]Contest: Beat the Boss of Zir'vitar Temple![/h1]

And yes, we have another [b]contest[/b] for you! And again, it's about that dungeon!

[b]Show us how you beat the boss of Zir'vitar Temple[/b]! 

Just create a [b]public video[/b] (Youtube, Twitch, doesn’t matter) and send us a link to [b]contest@radicalfishgames.com[/b]. 
You can add your live reaction or leave it out, whatever you prefer!

And just so you know who the boss is... [b]it's this guy[/b]:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/appear-teaser.gif[/img]

Among all people who send us the video, we’ll draw the following prize:
[b]You get your personal NPC guest role in Basin Keep[/b]! You can be an Avatar, a regular citizen or maybe something else? We’ll work together to figure out the details!
[b]Deadline: Sunday, October 9, 23:59 PDT[/b]

And that's all! Have fun with 0.8 and let's just hope there won't be too many bugs... but anyway, we'll try to fix them as early as possible!

[b]PS:[/b] Sorry for a lot of golden chests. Some of those are likely to be replaced with accessible chests in the sub releases of the next few days - we just didn't get around to decide for proper content yet.

[h1]HOT FIX 0.8.0-2[/h1]
We just released the first hotfix that solves some critical issues like crashes in the beginning and unsolvable sliding block puzzles!

Just create a [b]public video[/b] (Youtube, Twitch, doesn’t matter) and send us a link to [b]contest@radicalfishgames.com[/b]. 
You can add your live reaction or leave it out, whatever you prefer!

And just so you know who the boss is... [b]it's this guy[/b]:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/appear-teaser.gif[/img]

Among all people who send us the video, we’ll draw the following prize:
[b]You get your personal NPC guest role in Basin Keep[/b]! You can be an Avatar, a regular citizen or maybe something else? We’ll work together to figure out the details!
[b]Deadline: Sunday, October 9, 23:59 PDT[/b]

And that's all! Have fun with 0.8 and let's just hope there won't be too many bugs... but anyway, we'll try to fix them as early as possible!

[b]PS:[/b] Sorry for a lot of golden chests. Some of those are likely to be replaced with accessible chests in the sub releases of the next few days - we just didn't get around to decide for proper content yet.

[h1]HOT FIX 0.8.0-2[/h1]
We just released the first hotfix that solves some critical issues like crashes in the beginning and unsolvable sliding block puzzles!

notes.title: Hi-Lights and 0.8 Release Date
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/highlight-16-09-25-600x333.png[/img]

Hello everyball!

End of September is drawing close and we promised an update to version 0.8. We'll keep that promise... with just a few days delay!

[b]The release of version 0.8 is scheduled for October 3, 2016[/b]!

Now, we have been very ambitious with this version. Originally we planned to release the whole jungle (the biggest area yet) together with a city (also pretty big) and the Shockwave dungeon - a huge dungeon consisting of 3 smaller sub dungeons with a total length greatly exceeding that of the previous dungeons. All of that in about 3 months (which was also the time we needed for the heat area released with version 0.6).

... Sadly we didn't quite get this far. However, since it has been over 3 month, we don't want to postpone the release and instead just release what we managed to complete.

So here is what you get with version 0.8:
[list]
	[*]The new jungle area [b]Gaia's Garden[/b] with about 60% of the maps finished[/*]
	[*]The [b]Zir’vitar Temple[/b] which is 1 of the 3 planned sub dungeons[/*]
	[*]The central part of [b]Basin Keep[/b], the city inside the jungle[/*]
	[*][b]Autumn's Fall[/b] - a new area connecting Rookie Harbor with the jungle[/*]
	[*]The new [b]Wave Element Mode[/b] and maybe more combat arts for the other element modes, too[/*]
	[*]More [b]Quests[/b] in Bergen Trail and Village (and elsewhere)[/*]
	[*]The new [b]Status Menu[/b] with more detailed information about your stats and modifiers[/*]
[/list]
Okay, so this may look like only half of the content was completed... it's not quite as bad though! A lot of work already went into the remaining content so we should be able finish it rather quickly within the next 1 or 2 months.

[b]And now a few images of recent development![/b]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/to-the-dungeon.gif[/img]
Entering the new dungeon!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/bounce-puzzle-600x338.png[/img]
More insane bounce puzzles!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/wave-get.gif[/img]
Wave element mode upgrade!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/botanic-600x338.png[/img]
The new Botanic menu! Note: this feature may not be ready for version 0.8.

[h1]Gamedev Stream[/h1]
Oh yeah, and since it's Sunday, just a quick reminder that we'll have a [b]gamedev stream[/b] today:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/lea-stream-600x368.jpg[/img]

Stream will be live at: [url=http://twitch.tv/radicalfishgames]twitch.tv/radicalfishgames[/url]
Today we'll work on [b]Basin Keep[/b], adding NPCs and more details.

If you have any question about the next release or anything else, feel free to drop by and ask in the chat!

And that's all - Radical Fish out!

notes.title: CrossWeek completed!
notes.notes:
The 4th CrossWeek has just been completed! 6 Radical Fishes met somewhere in Hannover and worked on CrossCode full-time for 8 days straight!
It has been a tremendously productive time - and also a lot of fun!

This was the first CrossWeek where we used a proper [b]Task Board[/b]! 

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/IMG_1998-600x450.jpg[/img]That was the task board after the first day!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/IMG_20281-600x800.jpg[/img]...and here at the end of the CrossWeek. We managed to finish almost all the tasks we set out to complete and more!

And here is roughly what we did:

[list]
[*][b]9[/b] new enemies spritesheets completed including two midboss enemies![/*]
[*][b]7[/b] enemies fully implemented with plenty of fierce attacks and tricky weak spots[/*]
[*][b]8[/b] new jungle maps created with rough terrain for crazy jumping puzzles[/*]
[*][b]6 1/2[/b] jungle maps filled with lovely details and vines everywhere[/*]
[*][b]30+[/b] new sounds added for puzzle elements, background and enemies[/*]
[*]Several small technical features, bugfixes and internal editors[/*] 
[*]A lot of progress on a new CrossCode poster![/*]
[/list]

And because numbers are pretty boring, here some images and GIFs:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/ghost-enemy.gif[/img]
GHOSTS?!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/water-monster-madness.gif[/img]
FISH?!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/jungle-mapping2-600x360.png[/img]
JUNGLE?!?!

We also had a fun time in general!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/IMG_1991-600x800.jpg[/img]Doing ridiculous amounts of shopping!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/IMG_1999-600x450.jpg[/img]Fun cooking!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/IMG_2017-600x450.jpg[/img]Delicious food!

Everything was great... until the [b]burning[/b] started.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/IMG_1996-600x450.jpg[/img]Burning toast.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/IMG_2002-600x450.jpg[/img]Burning hamburger buns.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/burned-paddies-600x444.jpg[/img]Burning veggie-burger patties.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/IMG_2014-600x450.jpg[/img]Burning. Cereals.

So before we'd manage to burn down the entire kitchen, we decided to just go out for dinner on a Sunday. Also [b]Sezui[/b], one of our generous backers from the Indiegogo campaign, joined us!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/IMG_2006-600x450.jpg[/img]Very delicious burgers!

Following this, absolutely nothing else went wrong!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/crossweek-600x904.jpg[/img]

And this concludes our fourth CrossWeek!

Now it's time for the final sprint for [b]version 0.8[/b], that we still plan to release around [b]end of September[/b]!

notes.title: Hi-Lights of the unspecified time period + next CrossWeek!
notes.notes:
[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/highlight-30-08-16.png][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/highlight-30-08-16-600x333.png[/img][/url]

Hello everyball!

It's time for more Hi-Lights that we can't call "weekly" with a straight face anymore. Sorry!

But at least we are closing in towards the next big release, weeee~!

And there's also another special announcement further down!

Work towards [b]release 0.8[/b] is going steady.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/shockcat-ingame.gif[/img]

There's more [b]Jungle[/b]. With cute [b]shockingly cute kittens[/b]! They just want the cuddles! D:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/blobs.gif[/img]

And [b]surprisingly cooperative blobs[/b]. Well, with each other, of course.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/shock-dungeon-entrance.gif[/img]

Work on the new [b]dungeon[/b] also continues. You might be surprised, but it has a [b]shock[/b] theme!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/turnturn.gif[/img]

Only complete with [b]new puzzle-elements[/b]! What mysterious function could this have???

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/enemy-room.gif[/img]

Such idyllic peace. Nothing should go wrong here...

[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/Goat2ez3.png][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/Goat2ez3-600x338.png[/img][/url]

Speaking of things going wrong: The new batch of [b]sidequests for Bergen Village[/b] has recently been finished! The most recent one might involve goats and explosions, I'm not entirely sure, the plot is very complicated.

And that's it for the news about the game itself. We did make a lot of progress but sadly we once again forgot to do our regular update. We are very sorry for that, but we are certain that release 0.8 (coming out around [b]the end of September[/b]!) will make it up to you!

And now for our special announcement...

 
[h1]CrossWeek approaches![/h1]
Tomorrow a special period of time will once again begin. A time where many of those radical fishes from around Germany will swim to the promised city of Hannover, to make... game development. This is a sacred time, that of course is called: [b]CrossWeek[/b]!

From tomorrow the [b]30th of August till the 10th of September[/b], many of our team will have another CrossWeek-meetup to work full-time on CrossCode to get a lot of things ready for 0.8! And maybe also have some unrelated fun, if time and work ethic allows!

I hope you are looking forward to the results! There will definitely be another update in the next time!


Until we write again!

notes.title: Finally a new Trailer!
notes.notes:
It's been way over a year. Today we finally release a [b]new trailer[/b] for CrossCode:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6CuG6jId3MI

In there you can spot all kind of content from version 0.7 such as the new portraits, dungeons, and boss fights.

A big thank you to [b]Michael[/b] from [url=http://www.multimediaamdg.com/]MultiMedia AMDG[/url], who created the trailer for us dealing with all the feedback we threw at him for several weeks. Quite the achievement!
 
We hope you like the result! And if not: please tell us what you think so we can do a better job for the next trailer!

On another note: we also finally updated the [b]CrossCode Demo on Steam[/b] to include the new portrait and other details from version 0.7.1 (the scope stays the same). We also made sure it now works on Linux and OSX as well! 

The online demo on our webpage an other sites will be updated soon as well.

[h1]Recent Progress[/h1]

Since just showing a trailer makes for a pretty short post, here a bit of recent progress:


[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/jungle-mapping-600x507.png[/img]
After fully planning out the layout, [b]R.D.[/b] took on the task to map the [b]jungle[/b]. That's a big task. A very, very big task.

Meanwhile [b]Lachsen[/b] was busy creating new [b]puzzles elements[/b] like:


[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/shock-compressor.gif[/img]
The Compressed Shock Ball

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/wave-compressor.gif[/img]
The Compressed Wave Ball (it's different)

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/magnets.gif[/img]
Gravity-defying magnets

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/tesla-coil.gif[/img]
Tesla Coils

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/wave-teleport.gif[/img]
Strange Teleporters

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/wave-teleport-blocks.gif[/img]
Strange blocks strangely teleported with strange teleporters.



All the while [b]Frece[/b] and [b]T-Free[/b] are working hard on new [b]deadly enemies[/b] like:


[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/shockcat_tweet1.gif[/img]
Cats

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/wave-plant.gif[/img]
Plants

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/parrot.gif[/img]
and Parrots with Gatling Guns.


Finally, [b]GFluegel[/b] is creating more of these quests that [b]everybody will love unconditionally[/b]:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/monk-quest-nightmare-600x338.png[/img] 
DOESN'T THIS LOOK FUN.


That's all there is so far. Until the next devlog!

Okay, we know, we know. We're late again with our "weekly" Hi-Lights. We got got caught up in work and maybe playing Overwatch! So we're not to blame, right?

Anyway, let's get right into this because this Hi-Light has tons of new stuff for the upcoming update, so grab some popcorn and get comfy!

[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/path-01.png][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/path-01-600x338.png[/img][/url]
While the graphics for the new jungle area where done by Martina and Felix, Stefan finished up (yes, this area is already done!) a new and small area leading into the jungle called [b]Autumn's Fall[/b]. Sounds familiar? As you can see the theme is the same as Autumn's Rise but there are a lot of ruins this time. This area also connects to Autumn's Rise which means some maps have changed, uuuh mysterious.

[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/path-02.png][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/path-02-600x338.png[/img][/url]
Of course this also means new (and familiar) enemies! The area will also have new items to find for trading, so make sure to smash all these plants!

[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/city-progress-empty.gif][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/city-progress-empty.gif[/img][/url]
Once the graphics were done Felix started working on the [b]jungle city[/b]. Look at that shiny ground. As you can see this city will feature high buildings and dark street corners and a lot of laser powered billboards! 

[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/plants-integrated.png][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/plants-integrated-600x338.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/infested-jungle.gif][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/infested-jungle.gif[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/destructibles.gif][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/destructibles.gif[/img][/url]
Martina and Felix also created tons of [b]assets and props for the jungle[/b]. These images are test maps show-casing how the area will look in the future. 

[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/shock-temple.gif][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/shock-temple.gif[/img][/url]

[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/exterior.png][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/exterior-600x338.png[/img][/url]
As if that wasn't enough he managed to start work on the exteriors for both the shock and wave dungeon respectively. Those are still work in progress, hence the lack of detail as of now.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/interior-water-view-small.gif[/img]

Also: First steps for the interior of the dungeons!

[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/jungle-layout.png][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/jungle-layout-600x403.png[/img][/url]
Stefan recently started working out the layout of the jungle area. This is small excerpt of the layout right now. Rope bridges in jungle? Check!

[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/status-all.gif][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/status-all-small.gif[/img][/url]
Since we all know we need at least one new menu per update, Stefan added the [b]Status Menu[/b]. The last item missing from the main menu is finally here. Look at your stats while switching through elements to see how they change. This includes a long request feature: A list of all modifiers with description text, wuh! Click on it for better quality.

And that's all for now! There is still much to do, but that also means the next update will be [b]huge[/b]!

notes.title: CrossCode s Update Expands On Its Best Part: The Story
notes.notes:
CrossCode [official site] is a Japanese-inspired action RPG about hurling great big balls of energy to kill enemies in a fictional MMORPG. CrossCode deftly blends a lot of different retro-ish inspirations and looks great doing it. Our resident Lord of the Dance, Marsh Davies, thought so when he waltzed through its world, noting that the game-within-a-game narrative was a “surprisingly multilayered fiction, which, despite the chirpy caricatures, feels like it might go bleakly Ghost in the Shell at any moment.” And now that story is just a wee bit bigger with a new update this week.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: CrossCode 0.7 Release!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/version-up-0.71-600x348.jpg[/img]

Here we go! Today we release CrossCode version 0.7.0 that will finally [b]extend the story[/b], include the often requested [b]Trader Book[/b] and comes with a couple [b]new quest[/b]. And finally: the first wave of new character portraits!

[h1]New Portraits and Character Graphics[/h1]
As [url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/?p=4480]previously announced[/url] we plan to rework all the portraits of the game for a new polished style. With 0.7 we introduce the first wave of new portraits for the majority of characters including Lea, Shizuka, Sergey, Carla, Emilie and Schneider. Here some examples:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/new-portraits-1-600x338.png[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/new-portraits-2-600x338.png[/img]


In addition to that, we also improved many other large-scale sprites of Lea including the title screen and menu:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/new-title-0.7-small1.gif[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/lea-menu-new-600x338.png[/img]

[h1]Extended Story[/h1]

The story was extended quite a bit by about [b]1 1/2 chapters[/b]. The plot now includes the visit of the [b]Temple Mine[/b] and end at your arrival at [b]Ba'kii Kum[/b]. Along the way there will be several small excursions as you'll meet new players... and a guild! Here a couple of impressions:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/exposition-600x338.png[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/schneider-contact-600x338.png[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/first-scholars-scene31-600x338.png[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/emilie-fajro-temple-600x338.png[/img]

Finally Emilie will also be more talkative around Bergen Trail and Village, commenting on enemies and also locations:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/emili-comments-600x338.png[/img]

[h1]Trader Book[/h1]

Many of you requested a feature to track all the traders in the game. We listened and with 0.7 we finally introduce: The [b]Trader Book[/b].

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/traders-menu-small1.gif[/img]

The Trader Book will list all the traders you meet on your adventure, sorted by location. You'll be able to see all the items they offer as well as all the items you need for the exchange.

[h1]More Quests[/h1]

Version 0.7.0 comes with a couple new quests as well. One of them is connected to the story, others are optional. Make sure to visit [b]all the faction buildings[/b]! Also these are not just your generic kill and fetch quests. This screenshot should give you an idea what to expect:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/new-quests-600x338.png[/img]

... or maybe you just wonder what the heck is going on there. Anyway, just try out the quest!

[h1]Other Stuff[/h1]

As usual, the release comes with a couple of bug fixes. An important one: we switched to a [b]new version of NW.js for Linux and Mac[/b] users. Hopefully this will remove the crashing problems of the 0.6.x versions! 

In addition to that, you will find the first [b]interior maps in Ba'kii Kum[/b], new [b]lore entries[/b], an [b]improved blue hedgehag[/b], and an all new [b]background theme for Faj'ro Temple[/b] (which will still be improved, but anyway)!

[h1]Next Steps[/h1]

With the story continued we'll now focus on [b]content[/b] again. Our goal for version 0.8 is the new [b]Jungle[/b] area. Since this update will be about the size of 0.6 we might need a bit more time again. But that also means you can expect a [b]buckload of content[/b] once it's done!

And that's all! We all hope you'll have a fun time with the new release! Also: if you find bugs, simply tell us. It's a major release and most of you know how it goes~

Until 0.7.1!

notes.title: CrossCode DevLog: Next Milestone + Live Stream
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It has been some time. Sadly, we didn’t get around to post those “Weekly Hi-Lights” every week recently, but that doesn’t mean that nothing happened. To the contrary!
Scroll on for recent progress + more announcements.

[h1]Release of Next Milestone[/h1]

About a month ago we released CrossCode version 0.6 with a focus on content. Our next [b]milestone 0.7[/b] will, as promised, finally extend the [b]story[/b]! Also you can expect a couple new features. Here are some screenshots and gifs:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/first-scholars-hq.gif[/img]
A couple new places and houses to visit!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/first-scholars-scene-600x338.png[/img]
Seeing new faces.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/exposition-scene.gif[/img]
Mandatory Exposition in [b]Bergen[/b].

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/shade-room-scene1-600x338.png[/img]
New stuff at the end of the [b]Temple Mine[/b].

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/first-scholars-scene3-600x338.png[/img]
...More scenes!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/traders-menu-small.gif[/img]
The new Trader List Menu for an overview of all traders

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/interior-shop1.png[/img]
Interiors for Ba’kii Kum!

[b]We plan to release Version 0.7 on June 18![/b] 
Yes, it’s fixed now! ...Let’s hope it works out!

[h1]Live Streams[/h1]

There is a certain kind of regular CrossCode event that has been going on for quite some time now and we just thought it would be good to shared it once again:

[url=http://twitch.tv/radicalfishgames][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/lea-stream-600x368.jpg[/img]
CrossCode Gamedev Live Streams[/url]


In those devstreams we work on CrossCode, show recent development, answer your questions and in general just chat around. Also there is often some nonsense drawing at the end.

The time is usually [url=http://www.timebie.com/std/centraleuropeansummer.php?q=20]Sundays 20:00 CEST / 11 am PDT[/url], but sometimes streams are canceled. 
That’s why from now on we will schedule each CrossCode Live stream as an event in Steam's community hub. Finally.

... And yes, the next gamedev stream is already [b]TODAY[/b].

And that’s it! We hope you look forward to the next milestone and maybe join us for today’s gamedev stream.

notes.title: CrossCode 0.6 Release!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/version-up-0.6-600x348.jpg[/img]

Welcome everyone and welcome back to this special occasion!

How special? Major new CrossCode-Release special! [b]Version 0.6[/b] has been released and with it one of the largest chunks of content we have ever released in one update! Lea will need to keep her cool to dish out some just deserts in the steaming hot new content!
But we better describe the new stuff properly before the sentence becomes too silly (too late).

[h1]New Area: Maroon Valley[/h1]

The last update ended with the snowy Mt. Bergen and the freezing cold of its Temple Mine, so what would be best for Lea to recover her frozen nose? Of course, a [b]desert[/b]! Introducing our huge new area, [b]Maroon Valley[/b].

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/impression-5-600x338.png[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/impression-6-600x338.png[/img]

As you’d expect from a desert, it is not only dry but also has less differences in altitudes compared to a mountain. That didn’t stop us from including many devilish jumping puzzles that have to be solved to find all the precious treasures hidden on the scorching sands!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/impression-9-600x338.png[/img]

But it’s not all dry and bleak. The oasis might be among the prettiest places we’ve ever created so far!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/treeeee-2-600x338.png[/img]

And of course we couldn’t fill it with Snowmen and Penguins (those belong on snowy mountains, Watson), so also included is an entire set of [b]new enemies[/b]!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/combat-collage-600x306.png[/img]

Meet cute scorpions and all their friends! And quickly find their weak points because blind attacks aren’t gonna cut it.

All in all, this area alone is huuuge and will keep you occupied for a long time, if you want to uncover all its secrets. But of course there is more…

[h1]New Settlement: Ba’kii Kum[/h1]

[b]Ba’kii Kum[/b] is the latest settlement to go with the new area. An old city in the desert mixed with some new technology and mostly inhabited by the thus unseen natives of the planet in CrossWorlds: [b]The Shad[/b].

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/impression-3-600x338.png[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/impression-2-600x338.png[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/impression-4-600x338.png[/img]

As of this update the city is still lacking in interior areas, NPCs and quests but the outside is already completed. It also has a lot of traders with entirely new items that will help you brave the new challenges!

[h1]New Dungeon: Faj’ro Temple[/h1]

Yes, there is also an entirely [b]new dungeon[/b] in this release, complete with enemies, puzzles with new mechanics and new abilities to unlock. So to progress, Lea has to explore the [b]Faj’ro Temple[/b], build by the Ancients a long time ago and, unlike the Temple Mine, untouched by human hand.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/impression-8-600x338.png[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/impression-1-600x338.png[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/impression-51-600x338.png[/img]

The main theme this time is [b]water in all its states[/b]. You will have to move it as floating bubbles, power mechanisms with steam, freeze it to create platforms… 

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/impression-31-600x338.png[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/hot-coals1.gif[/img]

You will see that water can not only be the source of life but also of brain-wrecking puzzles.

Which also brings us to the big treasure of this new area: The second element, Cold!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/cold-arts.gif[/img]

A completely new skill tree and 4 new Combat Arts are at your disposal to defeat puzzles and enemies alike!

… And then, there is the [b]boss[/b]. Again, we’ll leave it to you to find out what waits at the end of Faj’ro Temple! In fact, we again have a small contest for you! Read more on that further below.

[h1]Finalized Shop Menu[/h1]

For a long time we had a very bare bones shop menu where you could only buy one item at a time and also not sell anything. Well, these times are over. Shopping is now just as familiar as browsing through your favorite online store. Find an item you like? Put in the amount you want in you cart and buy everything in a bulk with a nice list of what you’re buying.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/buying1-600x338.png[/img]

Selling works exactly the same with the only difference being that you get money and not lose it.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/selling-600x338.png[/img]

Speaking of money, trading is a vital part of CrossCode for getting equipment with all kinds of modifiers. Something we wanted to add from the start now finally found its way into the game: having a fee for trading. This was part of a new wave of balancing additions to make sure you don’t have too much or not enough of something.

[h1]Quests and more[/h1]

As with most of our updates this one contains a bunch of [b]new quests, items and lore[/b]. Most of the new quests can be found in Rookie Harbor or Bergen, but you can also find new ones in Bergen Trail and Autumn’s Rise. 

And speaking of Autumn’s Rise. Remember all the cargo crew members you could find in the area? We finally got around and removed/replaced them. Everyone except Carla, so you can still reset your skill trees. This also means that the captain quest, the Old Observatory and the Blue Weird Guy are gone. But fret not as we plan to bring their quests back in a better fashion. Expect some beefy changes to the Old Observatory in the next version. 

[h1]Contest: Beat the Boss of Faj’ro Temple![/h1]

Remember that contest we did back with the Temple Mine? We’re doing it again!
[b]Show us how you beat the boss of Faj’ro Temple[/b]! Just create a [b]public video[/b] (Youtube, Twitch, doesn’t matter) and send us a link to [b]contest@radicalfishgames.com[/b]. 
You can add your live reaction or leave it out, whatever you prefer!

And just so you know - [b]this is the room of the final boss[/b]:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/boss-room-600x338.png[/img]

Among all people who send us the video, we’ll draw the following prize:
[b]You get your personal NPC guest role in Ba’kii Kum[/b]! You can be an Avatar, a Shad or maybe something else? We’ll work together to figure out the details!
[b]Deadline: Friday, Mai 13, 23:59 PDT[/b]

[h1]Next Steps[/h1]

So much new content right? Yet, the story is still stuck all the way back in Bergen Trail. We’ll work on that next! Milestone 0.7 will once again extend the story and bring more life to all those new areas!

And that’s all! Have fun with the new release, everyone. We’re waiting for your feedback ... and bug reports!

notes.title: DevLog: Next Milestone and new Portraits
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/lea-teaser.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Our last updated from April 1st included a couple of changes we decided to undo after all. :P
All joking aside though, there is a little bit of truth to the whole story: [b]We do plan to improve the portraits[/b]!
Also: today we announce the release date for [b]Milestone 0.6[/b] and tell you what you can expect.

[h1]Improved Portraits[/h1]
Now, except for the obvious mask covering the face - did you notice anything different about the April Fools portraits?

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/comparsonA.png[/img]

Well, let's take off that mask!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/faceReveal.gif[/img]

It's a new shiny and polished portrait!

Most reviews praise CrossCode's pixel art style and we're very happy about that! Still, occasionally we received feedback that the character portraits are somewhat lacking in comparison to the smaller sprites and environment graphics. Of course, it's impossible to be perfect in all respects and that's ok! And while it's tempting to fix every problem, overdoing this tends to block actual progress and delays the final release.

Yet, there is something critical about the current state of the portraits: It has a very strong impact on the first impression. In some instances people mentioned that they were initially "put off" by CrossCode, because they didn't like the look of the portraits. In the end it's the characters that will grab your attention first.

That's why we decided to revise our existing portraits. However, to make sure this won't delay our progress all that much, we got some help: [b][url=http://martyfun.tumblr.com/]Marty[/url][/b] and [b][url=http://reesemcm.tumblr.com/]Gran[/url][/b] of [b]10G Coin[/b] (creators of The Island and Springtime Warfare) join our team! Both being very talented artists, they help us with polishing the character designs and updating all the assets.

And these are the results so far:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/lea-comparison.png[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/shizuka-comparison.png[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/sergey-comparison.png[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/carla-comparison.png[/img]

Other graphics will be improved as well, for instance Lea within the character menu:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/menu-comparison.png[/img]

It will take some time to update all existing characters and their expressions. That's why we can't promise to release the new expressions with the next milestone. However, it will happen soon!

What do you think? How do you like the new portraits? For real this time. :D
[h1]Milestone 0.6[/h1]
It's about time we release a new version of CrossCode for real. However, you'll have to wait a little bit longer. That's because milestone 0.6 is going to be [b]HUGE[/b].

This milestone will include:
[list]
	[*]Maroon Valley - an expansive new environment beating both Bergen Trail and Autumn Rise in size[/*]
	[*]Ba’kii Kum - a new village you will find within Maroon Valley[/*]
	[*]Faj’ro Temple - a complete new dungeon full with puzzles and boss fights[/*]
	[*]10+ new enemies (...including the boss fights!)[/*]
	[*]The cold element[/*]
	[*]More quests and NPCs within Rookie Harbor and Bergen[/*]
	[*]Improve Trading and Shopping Menu - you can finally sell items![/*]
	[*]Improved party member AI[/*]
[/list]
It is essentially like merging two updates in one, really.

That's why we'll need a bit longer:
[b]We will release Milestone 0.6 in the Beginning of May.[/b]
[h1]Hi-Lights[/h1]
Finally, let's end today's DevLog with a couple of images of our recent development!


[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/dungeon-parallax-animation.gif[/img]
This is Faj’ro Temple from far away, now with animation!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/dungeon-exterior-entrance.gif[/img]
About time to enter the dungeon! This map will still be improved.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/quicksand-fallthrough.gif[/img]
A small impression of the puzzles inside Faj'ro Temple.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/map-beginning.png[/img]
Meanwhile, R.D. started working on the new village - Ba’kii Kum...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/GIF-SMALL.gif[/img]
... and also on finally implementing a proper shop menu - with selling option!




And that's all for today's update. We still got a lot to do, so April will be very busy. 

Until next time!

notes.title: CrossCode 0.5.2 Release! Including new Potraits and awesome Sound Effects
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/version-up-0.5.2-600x348.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

It's the start of a new month and some of you might have already predicted it. That's right, a new release! This one is smaller but includes some important changes! So let's get right into this.


[h1]New Potraits[/h1]

Creating such a large game with all these different kinds of characters made us realize something: We have to create tons of portraits graphics including multiple expressions, special poses and so on. Doing this for all these characters you'll find is quite the task. So we thought: "Hey, why don't we just simplify the workload by reducing the amounts of expressions and focus on important stuff instead?" I think you all agree that this is the best for us to make sure we can finish the game on time.

So let's put it in writing: 

[b]Today we announce that we reduce the amount of facial expression because we realized there are just too many of them![/b]

We're super exited and think you will all like these a lot. With this update we updated Lea, Shizuka, Sergey and Carla! Here, take a look:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/screen-1-600x338.png[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/screen-2-600x338.png[/img]

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/screen-3-600x338.png[/img]

As you can see we tried our best to improve on the criticism we occasionally receive from player regarding our portraits. What do you all think?

I know some of you think: That's all? You reduce the graphics and make them look prettier and that's all? Well, of course not! Because...

[h1]New Sound Effects[/h1]

Teflo has been working all night and day to create new sound effects which we think fit much much better than the ones we had before. The previous sounds just didn't fit in and sounded almost bland compared to the new ones. We never thought we would achieve this kind of immersions just by improving sounds, so please try them.

You can download the new version of CrossCode via Steam right now or DRM-free versions when you backed the game on Indiegogo! We're eager to hear your opinion on our new portraits and the sounds!

See you all soon!

The Radical Fish Dev Team.

notes.title: CrossCode Release Postponed
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/crosscode-schedule-600x272.png[/img]
Many of you already saw that coming~
We worked hard and made lot of progress, yet there is still so much to do. That’s why we have to postpone the release of CrossCode.

[h1]One year ago…[/h1]

About a year ago, we started our Indiegogo campaign for CrossCode. When we finally reached our goal in Mai 2015 we targeted a release in Q2 2016. And then, full-time work started.

Let’s take a minute and think back about everything we created since then!

We introduced a ton of new features: [b]Trading Items[/b], [b]Item Destructibles[/b], [b]Quests[/b], the [b]Landmark System[/b], a new [b]Save Menu[/b], [b]Party Members[/b], [b]PvP Combat[/b], the [b]Encylopedia[/b], [b]Monster Fibula[/b], [b]Analyze Mode[/b] and more.

We also expanded the content, adding several new places like [b]Rookie Harbor[/b], [b]Bergen Trail[/b] and [b]Bergen Village[/b]. We also added the “[b]Temple Mine[/b]” a new dungeon complete with boss fight - all of which turned out to be pretty expansive, really. And then of course: [b]several dozens of new enemies[/b] for you to fight!

And finally, we [b]continued the story[/b], adding about 1-2 hours of narrated playtime.

Yes, a lot has happened. Yet, there is still much more to do. We could release CrossCode in Q2 2016, but then we’d have to cut content. We don’t want this. It’s important to us, that the final game will hold up to your expectations and tell the full story as we planned it. That’s why we will postpone the release and use that extra time to make CrossCode truly complete!

[b]The new release of CrossCode is scheduled for Early 2017.[/b]

[h1]A small present for all Player Perk Backers[/h1]

Today, every Indiegogo backer with a “[b]Player[/b]” perk receives an [b]Early Access Key[/b] as well!

Originally, we promised all those backers the final game. With the release further postponed, we thought it would be fair to give those people the option to play the Early Access version now as well.
Of course, the same key will give you access to the final game, once it’s completed!

[b]Here is how you get your key[/b]:

1. Visit central.cross-code.com
2. If not done already click “Request Password” and submit your Indiegogo E-Mail to request a password for access
3. Login with E-Mail and Password
4. You’ll find your Steam Key + DRM Free version right on the first page

[h1]Recent progress[/h1]

And just to show you that development still goes fast, here again a summary of our recent progress!

[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/trades.png][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/trades-600x338.png[/img][/url]

You now additionally spend [b]Credits [/b]when trading items. Finally a way to get rid of all that money!

We started working on new [b]Puzzles[/b] for the Heat Dungeon!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/bubbles.gif[/img]
Here you see [b]water bubbles[/b] and [b]propellers[/b]...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/ice-disk.gif[/img]
... the [b]Freezebee[/b]...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/water-blocks-2.gif[/img]
... physically accurate [b]water blocks[/b]...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/quicksand.gif[/img]
... [b]quicksand[/b]...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/pipes.gif[/img]
... strangely [b]glowing pipes[/b]...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/elemental-poles2.gif[/img]
... and finally: [b]Elemental poles[/b]!

We also made a lot of progress with [b]Maroon Valley[/b]! All maps have been roughly created (including some feisty puzzles) and we also worked on weather effects...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/sandstorm.gif[/img]
...like this [b]sand storm[/b]!

And finally we're also working on [b]new quests[/b] in the Rookie Harbor area!

And that’s all!

Sorry to make you wait longer, but we hope that this extra time will help to make CrossCode the one ball-throwing adventure you’ll never forget!

Today, every Indiegogo backer with a “[b]Player[/b]” perk receives an [b]Early Access Key[/b] as well!

Originally, we promised all those backers the final game. With the release further postponed, we thought it would be fair to give those people the option to play the Early Access version now as well.
Of course, the same key will give you access to the final game, once it’s completed!

[b]Here is how you get your key[/b]:

1. Visit central.cross-code.com
2. If not done already click “Request Password” and submit your Indiegogo E-Mail to request a password for access
3. Login with E-Mail and Password
4. You’ll find your Steam Key + DRM Free version right on the first page

[h1]Recent progress[/h1]

And just to show you that development still goes fast, here again a summary of our recent progress!

[url=http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/trades.png][img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/trades-600x338.png[/img][/url]

You now additionally spend [b]Credits [/b]when trading items. Finally a way to get rid of all that money!

We started working on new [b]Puzzles[/b] for the Heat Dungeon!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/bubbles.gif[/img]
Here you see [b]water bubbles[/b] and [b]propellers[/b]...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/ice-disk.gif[/img]
... the [b]Freezebee[/b]...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/water-blocks-2.gif[/img]
... physically accurate [b]water blocks[/b]...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/quicksand.gif[/img]
... [b]quicksand[/b]...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/pipes.gif[/img]
... strangely [b]glowing pipes[/b]...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/elemental-poles2.gif[/img]
... and finally: [b]Elemental poles[/b]!

We also made a lot of progress with [b]Maroon Valley[/b]! All maps have been roughly created (including some feisty puzzles) and we also worked on weather effects...

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/sandstorm.gif[/img]
...like this [b]sand storm[/b]!

And finally we're also working on [b]new quests[/b] in the Rookie Harbor area!

And that’s all!

Sorry to make you wait longer, but we hope that this extra time will help to make CrossCode the one ball-throwing adventure you’ll never forget!

notes.title: CrossCode Version 0.5 Release! Let's go!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/version-up-0.5-600x348.jpg[/img]

Hello and welcome!

It's finally time for a new version of CrossCode! And boy it has a lot of new stuff! We have menus, story, content and... [b]Linux and MacOS[/b] versions in store! So let's get right to it!

[h1]The Story Continues[/h1]
As promised the story of CrossCode will continue with the 0.5 release. After arriving in Rookie Harbor you'll now get a proper introduction into CrossWorlds and what this game is about:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/expo-space.gif[/img]

You'll also get the chance to have a duel with a certain someone:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/apollo-duel.gif[/img]

It's time to see who the better Speromancer is!

Huh? What about Emilie? Ah! Of course we can't forget one of the biggest new features we added to CrossCode:
[h1]Party Members[/h1]
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/emilie-battle.gif[/img]

That's right! Emilie joins the fight as Ai-controlled Party member. And just like you might have guessed she will be using a lot of close ranged attacks combined with quick dodges. Now you can pummel foes with even more style! Perfect Guard an enemy and let Emilie finished the job, no problem!
We're really happy about this feature and we hope you all have a lot of fun with it.

But fret not if you think Emilie will steal the show! You can adjust her behavior by using the new [b]Party Strategy[/b] Menu in the Quick Menu:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/ai-600x338.png[/img]

All party members will follow your lead immediately. So if you rather want to fight along, you can still do so. Some party of the story might require you to keep a party member for a set amount of time but you will be able to switch them out eventually. How, you ask? Why through the [b]Social Menu[/b] of course!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/invite-600x338.png[/img]

This menu lists all your contacts and let's you invite them into your party (which can consist of up to 3 people). You can also just contact them if you want to chat:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/contact-600x338.png[/img]

Speaking of menus, we also added a bunch of new menus that were long overdue!
[h1]Encyclopedia, Records & Monster Fibula[/h1]
After a certain point in the story you will now gain the [b]Disc of Insight[/b] which grants you access to 3 new menus in the Synopsis section.
[h1]Encyclopedia[/h1]
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/lea-600x338.png[/img]

The Encyclopedia is a compendium of all the lore in CrossCode, that includes your Story progression, Characters, in-game lore of CrossWorlds and Real World lore which covers topics like the M.S. Solar cargo ship or what company created CrossWorlds. Each entry can have multiple paragraphs and pages. The progress for each one is reflected by the completion percent on the right side of the entry.
[h1]Records[/h1]
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/general-600x338.png[/img]

The Records Menu is CrossCode in numbers. Everything from "Total exp gained in combat" to "Number of times Lea said 'hi'" is included (Yes, we count those). You'll also get some nice percent view of your total progress in CrossCode via this menu. For as long as the Early Access is active these percentages might be off from times to times as we add new stuff.
[h1]Monster Fibula[/h1]
[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/GIF3.gif[/img]

Finally the Monster Fibula. In this menu you find detailed information about every enemy you fought (and defeated). Once you defeated an enemy a certain number of times you'll unlock the second page which contains what we call [b]Reports[/b]. Reports are information on an enemy you found somewhere. However, the first entry is always unlocked. Currently not all enemies have reports so expect more of them in the next releases!
[h1]Analyze Mode[/h1]
Something we've planned from the very beginning has now found its way into the game, too! You can now analyze your environment!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/rock-600x338.png[/img]

Using the [b]Scope [/b]button in the quick menu you can hover over points of interest to reveal their purpose. To tell them apart each point can have a different color. For instance violett stands for traders or shopkeepers while blue if for regular NPCs. Their are also special types like the red ones in the screen above! Those are for enemies. By Just opening the quick menu you can see the level of an enemy. Hovering over an enemy reveals its base stats:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/meister-neu.gif[/img] Better watch out...

Quest NPCs will also be visible immediately once you entered the quick menu. This way you'll always know where you can find an important quest-related character. This also allows us to create interesting quests where you have to use the [b]Analyze Mode[/b] to find something otherwise hidden.
[h1]Other Updates[/h1]
Beside these big new features we also changed small things and worked on existing features and areas. One of those is Bergen Village which finally gets more crowded. It's not quite where we want it but still, it's an improvement:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/life-600x338.png[/img]

As you can see Bergen now has it's own set of NPCs graphics! The Quest Hub in Rookie Harbor also got a make over and is now swarming with players:

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/quest-hub2-600x338.png[/img]

Apart from this, there are smaller changes like the new Tutorials which will only popped once when you first took on a quest or learned a combat art.

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/tutorial-gui.gif[/img] Also visible here are the new updates messages you get when finding a landmark. This will also pop up when solving a quest task. If you rather want to use the old style on the right side of the screen you can change the setting in the Options Menu!
Speaking of the Options Menu, since we added the Social Menu we decided to move the Options Menu to the Pause Screen to avoid having to much menu options in the main menu.

And last but not least we also have new sounds for various actions in CrossCode as well as a new theme for Bergen Village! Check it out right here:

https://soundcloud.com/interovgm/bergen-village
[h1]Linux and MacOS Version[/h1]
We finally took some time to work on the Linux and MacOS Versions of the game, or better the build process and getting it to run in Steam. With the 0.5 version we'll be providing a first build for both systems. However it's very much a work in progress and errors might occur. Hopefully everything will work right away!

----

Phew~ Alright! That's all for the 0.5 Version! Or wait... there is one final thing...

AUTOSAVE!

[img]http://www.radicalfishgames.com/wp-content/uploads/auto-600x338.png[/img]
We finally added it! Who needs saving anyway?

----

Alright everyball, that's it! We hope you enjoy the new version just as much as we enjoyed working on it! We're eager to here your feedback (both good and bad). We'll have a follow up next week to tell you more about our milestone for 0.6 so stay tuned.

Until next time!
